## We Have Not Been Told The ENTIRE Truth About America
---
Recently, I asked my three oldest kids (_Hannah_ , _Ashton_ & _Blitz_) why we celebrate the Fourth of July? They said, "Because we got our freedom from Great Britain." I then asked a question, "Why did we want freedom from Great Britain?" They then shouted in chorus, "**NO TAXATION WITHOUT REPRESENTATION!** " I said, "That's right... kind of." Then, I gave my kids a short history of our great country. My three kids gave the answer we have all been taught. We have been taught that our ancestors came over to America in search of **gold** and that they separated from Great Britain over **taxes**. This is called an economic approach to history. While this is partially true, **there is much more that we have not been taught**. Did you know there are actually **twenty-seven reasons listed in the Declaration of Independence** as to why our Founders decided it was necessary to fight a war for Independence? "No taxation without representation" was actually grievece **seventeen of the twenty-seven**. What is listed eleven times is "**Representative Abuse** ", which is **elite rulers** infringing upon the God-given rights that are granted to individuals created in the image of God (sounds very similar to today). Our separation from Great Britain was not just for financial reasons but also **biblical reasons**. It is the same with our ancestors and their desire to come to America in the first place. In 1504, **Christopher Columbus** said "_I was led of the Holy Spirit to carry the message of the Gospel to undiscovered lands_." In the **Mayflower Compact** it is stated that they had come to America for "_the glory of God and the advancement of the Christian faith_." The original thirteen colonies had charters that presented why they decided to form these new colonies. The **Virginia Charter** states that the colony of Virginia was formed for the right of people to live in "_Christian peace_ " and instruct the people to "_Propagate the Christian religion to such people who yet live in ignorance of the true knowledge and worship of God_." The **Delaware Charter** states that the colony of Delaware was formed "_To further propagate the Holy Gospel_." To say that the reason our ancestors came to America was exclusively in search for riches and gold (an economic approach to history) is not only wrong but historically dishonest. America was formed to be a Christian nation with a divine purpose. name: Candace Owens
subject: The most personal email I’ve ever sent you
body:
Now I’ll share my story... racism, death threats, and empowering black communities.
[View this message in your browser](http://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2zp7jm0rjvflrtko5k8lfbuqeiq11l3hk8ng5mmdo_rp22sh2s8i66pb7chie1p75cdh238h5e8he485he5o75pt7kkpqcdtjmpqj4srk65qb6t9j6toj79hnmmrq8cjm62qb6t9nkjhf4onncph3apr3e2rmbcb6mdon3dbimcq78p5ke3j63d9kmcq72dbichgn4or0sljreduie1p64pjgm9j71p5jcdg74dr662qbad30etimcc9gm9j61o5lcdge1d9h66qj3dbi4no)
[](http://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2z8mosn7nq5ae1on7qpeuo8c4624s1im7hk7n9ls0_rp22sh2s8i66pb7chie1p75cdh2bs)

Friend,

This is the most personal and vulnerable email I have ever sent you... But I must share my story and tell you why I created the BLEXIT Foundation.

Before I share my story, allow me to introduce the BLEXIT Foundation.

**For too long, I have watched Black Americans force-fed a message of victimhood, fear, defeat, and dependence. And, this has to stop.** In 2019, with Brandon Tatum, we created BLEXIT Foundation - a nonprofit organization - dedicated to bringing traditional American principles and a message of empowerment to urban minority communities.

Our message to America's black and minority communities is that you are not a victim. We promote economic independence and individual freedom, strengthening the nuclear family, and fostering a deeper appreciation for patriotism in Black American culture.

[_**Please support the BLEXIT Foundation 's mission today by helping me reach our goal of raising $25,000 from new online donors. You can click here to donate.**_](http://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2zi8erodep5mjl3fus0jcm0shnnro7pr09btt6mno_rp22sh2s8i66pb7chie1p75cdh2bs)

**_Now I 'll share my story_... racism, death threats, and empowering black communities.**

Growing up as a black woman, I can recall learning how "helpless" I was told I was. And this message - which the media forces Black Americans to listen to - is heartbreaking.

We're taught to believe we're victims, that nothing will ever change, the police are our enemies, and racism prevents us from ever achieving our goals.

This is WRONG.

I've dealt with racism... _**I 've even received death threats**_. Racism is an ugly form of collectivism and is unacceptable.

But the solution is NOT to become a victim and give up.

I created the BLEXIT Foundation to empower black communities, minorities, and the people in my life whom I love. Since our start in 2019, BLEXIT has grown substantially with over 41 grassroots chapter programs in 41 states, over 14,000 volunteer members and local community leaders, and nearly 60,000 grassroots supporters.

[_**Friend, I am inviting you to support the BLEXIT Foundation and help us spread our winning message of entrepreneurship, school choice, faith, and family. My goal is to raise $25,000 from online supporters to fund our mission. Please click here to donate $10, $50, $100, $250, $500, $1,000 or any amount. **_](http://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2zl7dm4st170f3jmprf4q86sfesvs43si2ka6f7kg_rp22sh2s8i66pb7chie1p75cdh2bs)

I am breaking the rules.

It seems like every email I receive in my inbox engages in fear-mongering, makes big promises, and demands you and I make a donation without any of the details... _I 'm not doing that_.

You should know the details, believe in our mission, and understand how BLEXIT is changing the direction of our urban communities and our country.

So I am taking a risk by sending you a long email with all the details to empower YOU to choose to support the BLEXIT Foundation.**Please read to the end of this email (I have an important message at the end you don 't want to miss).**

When I founded BLEXIT, I wanted to make sure above all else we were NOT just a "think tank", but rather we pride ourselves on being a thoughtful and quick acting "DO-tank". We're doing things no other organization in the country is doing.

Here are the BLEXIT Foundation's values, what we're doing to reach Black communities, and what we're fighting for:

* **School Choice:** Often, the people allegedly "fighting for minorities" are doing everything in their power to keep Black and Hispanic students locked into awful schools.

The ugly truth is that these schools are simply brainwashing centers attacking the nuclear family, creating victims, and teaching their twisted values. BLEXIT is fighting for School Choice to empower young Black and Hispanic students to learn real skills, have more opportunities, and escape poverty. [_**You can support BLEXIT 's efforts to fight for School Choice here >>>**_](http://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2zdp85gjucsbmue86t97gu1pre58hrr8ctsrt6f8o_rp22sh2s8i66pb7chie1p75cdh2bs)

* **Criminal Justice Reform:** The mainstream media wants urban communities to hate our law enforcement officers. This ugly message is setting Black Americans back. The BLEXIT Foundation supports our men and women who serve as police officers and defend our communities.

Yes, we do need criminal justice reform. But we believe cooperating with our police officers and connecting as a community is critical to creating justice. BLEXIT Foundation is starting conversations with police officers and urban communities. The media wants you to believe cops are evil! This is wrong. But people never hear this message.

[_**Help the BLEXIT Foundation change the narrative by making a donation here >>>**_](http://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2za8j6d7uq5iftjlf98ghec1no4ot9hc4v9lile38_rp22sh2s8i66pb7chie1p75cdh2bs)

* **Entrepreneurship:** I am passionate about empowering Black and Hispanic Americans. Free markets, responsibility, and advancing the careers of urban communities is the solution to poverty. The BLEXIT Foundation identifies young leaders in urban communities and helps them create resumes, practice interviews, and learn skills employers desire.

BLEXIT is not a book club or simply talking a big game... No, we're actually making an impact with real individuals committed to serving urban communities. [_**Please help the BLEXIT Foundation encourage entrepreneurship and empower Black and Hispanic communities by donating here >>>**_](http://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2ze9qqlmeijlvso8qpnsn2g2vfhjqgvu3d67jfnho_rp22sh2s8i66pb7chie1p75cdh2bs)

* **Teaching History: **Critical Race Theory has nothing to do with solving race relations in our country. This is about division and spreading a victimhood message.

The BLEXIT Foundation believes in teaching real American history. It is critical for our urban communities to learn about our Founding Fathers and the Constitution to become productive and educated citizens. [_**Please help the BLEXIT Foundation teach real American history by donating here >>>**_](http://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2z95290vt7scqaqc30l1tnhlou06tuv87svmq601g_rp22sh2s8i66pb7chie1p75cdh2bs)

* **Presenting Our Message: **We have failed to reach urban communities with our message and values. Instead, we've allowed the mainstream media to write the narrative. Not anymore.

The BLEXIT Foundation is going places where no one else goes. We're hosting events in Detroit, Baltimore, and Tampa and starting real conversations. We're not just preaching to the choir, and these aren't boring events. They have music, art, and real conversations, and they are fun! I am committed to reaching urban communities and spreading our message. [_**Please support BLEXIT 's events and help us spread our message by donating here >>>**_](http://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2z4b2am98mpn5fr182sqchb9iojiamt55bv2ggr78_rp22sh2s8i66pb7chie1p75cdh2bs)

What does "BLEXIT" mean? BLEXIT is the Black exit from the culture of victimhood, fear, and dependence the media has forced on us. If you hold a permanent view of yourself as a victim you become your own oppressor.

This is personal to me.

I was once a slave to a culture of victimhood and became a proud Black patriot.

Friend, I am asking you to join the BLEXIT Foundation by making an investment in our organization. Please use one of the links I've copied below to donate today:

[_**Donate $10 >>>**_](http://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2z7ec8ld37emm5ph6im7rv4onpsv85k2ehj60hjv8_rp22sh2s8i66pb7chie1p75cdh2bs)
[_**Donate $35 >>>**_](http://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2z8ij1843r96scc9127642kjvlcg32mcu521rf2l8_rp22sh2s8i66pb7chie1p75cdh2bs)
[_**Donate $50 >>>**_](http://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2zg6mktvsn2itafr1dbo9io6s0g1bgji504j7mtjo_rp22sh2s8i66pb7chie1p75cdh2bs)
[_**Donate $100 >>>**_](http://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2zkbf62sb0c1b3mb93c4615lc753jcs2576j3cn1g_rp22sh2s8i66pb7chie1p75cdh2bs)
[_**Donate $250 >>>**_](http://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2z5keqeu695lhcfco4as8ci6iq18drcutlshu2bb0_rp22sh2s8i66pb7chie1p75cdh2bs)
[_**Donate $500 >>>**_](http://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2zbvvskt7pp9of6r4hhil4lfogaous781v88t1d10_rp22sh2s8i66pb7chie1p75cdh2bs)
[_**Donate $1,000 >>>**_](http://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2zc02l1tshma9gnh01h24aeo6d0qonkbc7bhal820_rp22sh2s8i66pb7chie1p75cdh2bs)
[_**Donate $2,500 >>>**_](http://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2zm1u2o57q71sgoua53e391kr34r1g0tg9litecj8_rp22sh2s8i66pb7chie1p75cdh2bs)
[_**Donate Any Amount >>>**_](http://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2z4v2a0d868504qejk1ot6velj9dm5vgko6ccocj0_rp22sh2s8i66pb7chie1p75cdh2bs)

This is my last message to you before you close this email.

The BLEXIT Foundation believes in faith, family, and freedom. At the end of the day, our message to urban communities is about love and empowerment.

My burning desire is to use my voice and change the direction of our urban communities and the country. The BLEXIT Foundation has a real impact, and I am inviting you to join our cause.

[_**Please consider making the most generous donation you can today by clicking here.**_](http://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2zuocvobfm7pfbpjdljbv15d30dpei7ghcn6ii598_rp22sh2s8i66pb7chie1p75cdh2bs)

Thank you, Friend.

Candace Owens
President
BLEXIT Foundation

body:
I called on the Dept. of Justice to monitor the police investigation here in Akron, Ohio.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/47495729/354535877/-1502561798?refcode=EM_C_220707Walker_RR_SB_90DO_8_NG_logo&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84Nzg0NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxMzBjZjBlNi1mOGZkLWVjMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=9Jcsww99x8krwyiIieBMQoxVq10IcP7DpNyqMq5EkuY=&emci=32d0ad81-35fa-ec11-b47a-281878b83d8a&emdi=130cf0e6-f8fd-ec11-b47a-281878b83d8a&ceid=23746811) I want to inform you of what is happening here in Akron, Ohio, Peter.

On June 28, a Black man, Jayland Walker, was killed at the hands of eight police officers. These police officers released ninety shots during the altercation. At this very moment, the City of Akron and the Akron Police Department are conducting an investigation into what occurred that would cause so much violence against one man.

I join each and every one of you in the Akron community as we mourn this tragic loss. Jayland Walker was revered as a neighbor, brother, and nephew to so many.

I know many are brokenhearted to learn of this loss. And while I share the same sense of sorrow with you all, I am also gravely concerned.

For far too long, Black communities have been the victim of not just police violence, but also faulty police investigations into the events that caused their death. I refuse to let that happen here.

That’s why on Friday, I called upon the Department of Justice to monitor this investigation into Mr. Walker’s death to make sure the investigation is fair and just – and as of this weekend, they have accepted our calls for oversight. We owe it to his family, and the people of Akron, to uncover the truth of this tragic event, and I thank the Dept. of Justice for seeing the importance of this as well.

If we want to change this epidemic of unarmed Black men and women being killed at the hands of police, then we need accountability. Our communities need to know our police department is being transparent and neutral in this investigation. We need to know that we will be served the truth of what happened, not just a story that protects the police department. This is the only way to rebuild trust between our community and law enforcement agencies.

I want you to know that as your Congresswoman, I am doing everything in my power to ensure a thorough investigation into this matter. I will continue every day to put pressure on officials until our communities know the whole truth. And as we await the results of the investigation, know that I am here for each and every one of you. Thank you,

Peter,

Every woman deserves the right to make her own personal reproductive health care decisions without political interference. But last month, nearly 50 years of precedent were undone when the Supreme Court overturned _Roe v. Wade_ and millions of women lost power over their bodies and lives.

This Supreme Court's ruling is disastrous and tragic, and Republicans aren't just stopping at overturning _Roe_. Senate Minority Leader Mitch McConnell said a ban that would make abortion illegal nationwide is "possible" and House Minority Leader Kevin McCarthy proposed a national ban on abortion.

Seth's opponent, Allan Fung, opposed codifying _Roe v. Wade_ in Rhode Island and was endorsed by RI Right to Life, a group that wants to make abortion illegal.

It's never been more important that we elect pro-choice Democratic leaders to Congress to fight back against attacks on reproductive rights. In Congress, Seth will fight to ensure reproductive rights are protected for all, support codifying _Roe_ into federal law nationwide, and block states from enacting barriers to accessing abortion care.

Peter,
We’re just 12 days away from primary Election Day in Maryland, and Early Voting Centers are now open across the state. I want to make sure you have the information you need to make a plan to vote and ensure that your voice is heard in this important election.
Election Day is Tuesday, July 19th. But you don’t have to wait until then to cast your ballot. Across the district, early voting sites are open today through July 14th from 7:00 am until 8:00pm. You can vote at any early voting site in your county. For a list of sites near you, click here. [https://elections.maryland.gov/elections/2022/2022_Early%20Voting_Centers.pdf]
If you’ve requested an absentee or mail-in ballot, you should be receiving it soon (if you haven’t already). If you’d like to receive your ballot by mail, requests must be received by next Tuesday, July 12th. Be sure to carefully follow instructions on your mail-in ballot to ensure that your vote is counted.
This election couldn’t be more important. We need to ensure that we get out the vote in order to prepare for a fight in November. Here are a few important steps to take to ensure that your voice is heard this year:

And we’re keeping up that momentum in July: yesterday, Cecile Richards, longtime former president of Planned Parenthood, endorsed me, too! body:
Friend, you need to know this information. [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/BC.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c210334%7c9335%7c8%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz%7c805&wdmdk=ndfGWKhhAMc3jrTnBrpdSg&sysid=1)
Friend, you need to know this information.

Friend,

I thought you should be the first to know: 30 yr. Career politician Patty Murray IS SPENDING MILLIONS on a smear campaign against me. _She will do**ANYTHING** to get re-elected._

Murray knows a [**RED WAVE IS COMING TO WASHINGTON**](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c37057%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=1K8hhAUp0HTyXxx63zSARQ&sysid=1) , and she’s desperate to stop it.

Unlike Murray, I am not bought by dark money mega donors-- I don’t have millions to fight back against her attacks. I fully rely on grassroots supporters like YOU who are sick and tired of the status quo.
[](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c37058%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=t4v8TkW3ht6JFDP6TvWIlg&sysid=1)
Patty Murray MUST GO, but I can’t do it without your support, Friend.

**It’s only July and I’m being outspent by a 30yr. career politician who has a long record of abandoning middleclass Americans when they need HELP the most.**

[**I need your help TODAY to fight back against her smear campaign.**](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c37059%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=zUdm4JF9iX4p7nHfQwgOIA&sysid=1)
**[**RUSH GRASSROOTS SUPPORT**](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c37050%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=7%2b5AHpWDaCQjAIYHCURQlg&sysid=1)**

---

**Sorry Patty, there’s a new mom in town and I will NOT be intimidated.**

See you in November,

Tiffany Smiley

* * *
**Our country needs leadership, Friend.**
We need someone who will stand up and work to solve our nation's problems. I’m a proven leader, I’ve stood up to the DC bureaucrats at the VA to pave the way for ALL veterans to receive the care and treatment they deserve when they return home. Our veterans are willing to pay the ultimate price for our everyday freedoms. But when they come back home, their service is often overlooked by our very own government.
After serving our nation and laying their lives on the line overseas, our veterans should **NOT** have to beg to get the care they deserve here at home. We need to do better for those who defend our nation, Friend.
**That's why I'm running for Senate**

Wade, the basic rights of millions of women will now come down to this next election. I am proudly pro-choice and as your Congresswoman, I will work relentlessly to defend the right to choose for every single person in this country. But my opponent, Erik Aadland, is staunchly anti-choice. He has said he would vote AGAINST Roe v. Wade protections in Congress. He opposes Colorado’s reproductive rights laws. And he’s backed by millions of dollars in spending by some of the most extreme anti-choice groups in the country. body:
The Democrats are spending MILLIONS [](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/BC.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c612934%7c6121%7c6%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz%7c1&wdmdk=4tGiyVUVV%2bDb5mto50WNFw&sysid=1)
The Democrats are spending MILLIONS

Friend,

Did you catch my interview on Fox News this morning?

It was great to share my story and talk about the incredible momentum behind my campaign for U.S. Senate.

I’m taking on a 30 year incumbent because I believe Washingtonians deserve someone in the Senate who will fight for the issues they care about in their daily lives.

_**Recent polls show me surging ahead, and the Democrats are so scared I’ll flip Washington red that they’re spending MILLIONS to try to stop my momentum.**_

I’m doing everything I can to stand up against the career politicians, but I can’t win this fight alone. While the Democrats have mega-donors and dark money funding my opponent, I rely on my grassroots supporters like YOU, Friend. [****](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c63361%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=Wq0Pkn1AsIzM6NiYQCVCpA&sysid=1)
[**
Please, can you help my campaign by chipping in any amount?**](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c63362%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=Zwcl9OiGq9r7IJDMvqE4cw&sysid=1)

As a veterans advocate and triage nurse, I have spent my whole life serving my community. Now, I’m ready to continue that service from the U.S. Senate.

Are you with me?
**[**SUPPORT MY CAMPAIGN**](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c63363%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=PjXirMnkajrPA9btMBJWaw&sysid=1)**

---

Thank you,

Tiffany Smiley

[](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c63362%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=Zwcl9OiGq9r7IJDMvqE4cw&sysid=1)

* * *
**Our country needs leadership, Friend.**
We need someone who will stand up and work to solve our nation's problems. I’m a proven leader, I’ve stood up to the DC bureaucrats at the VA to pave the way for ALL veterans to receive the care and treatment they deserve when they return home. Our veterans are willing to pay the ultimate price for our everyday freedoms. But when they come back home, their service is often overlooked by our very own government.
After serving our nation and laying their lives on the line overseas, our veterans should **NOT** have to beg to get the care they deserve here at home. We need to do better for those who defend our nation, Friend.
**That's why I'm running for Senate**
[](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c63364%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=4WIkoY2qcbmQGRGq9EE%2bSQ&sysid=1)
[**If you agree we need to stand up for our nation’s heroes, will you chip in to help me reach my major upcoming goal? I need your support, Friend!**](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c63375%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=ADD2hdSb5koCGJ%2bCnYAo1Q&sysid=1)

body:
You can now own one of Hillsdale College’s most popular online courses, “Winston Churchill and Statesmanship,” on DVD.
[View this message in your browser](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2z9jrd92dk6ir9iijhnlfr1cpk4ii030r95pvkqc0_rp2ash2s8gb2sbgebjqf99jk1p7fcdkmcqjas3h6gonact66uqrf91ieoob9crl6uie5sj2ucob2or7m9o75cbjm5p7eob16lpbaob461rrctjicgobfchh61qm2sjj61qbbdtnq9o74oj6e2p6cs74mdhm0shncoqe9cr3curm4phh62p6co70mlhm1o5l64oracdle8gq48bi4bh28or5cth68or0s9hm49fg)
This sponsored message from Pro Life Update is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2z4rpq6e6bavihju7ft79rfvkklkem9d51c0q8ee8_rp22sh2s8i66pb7c9i66o72cdh2bs) Dear Fellow American, You can now own one of Hillsdale College’s most popular online courses, **“Winston Churchill and Statesmanship,”** on DVD. Thousands of people have enjoyed this in-depth course online since its release, _**and now you can add it to your personal library or give it as a gift.**_ In recent years Winston Churchill, who is best known for his leadership during World War II, has been portrayed in numerous films and television shows, proving without a doubt that Americans find the “British Bulldog” captivating. The reasons for this sustained interest in Churchill are profound. No statesman has better diagnosed the threat of modern technology; no statesman has spoken more effectively in opposition to socialism; and, no statesman has displayed more courage in the face of tyranny. It should come as little surprise that so many “academics” and activists are working to smear his legacy, which makes studying a true account of Churchill’s accomplishments more important than ever. **For precisely this reason, I am so excited to offer you this powerful DVD set:** **_[https://secure.hillsdale.edu/winston-churchill-dvd-offer/](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zjod57sik5q1958if4hcjfal6avk29foj5er2so8_rp22sh2s8i66pb7c9i66o72cdh2bs)_** As a student of Dr. Arnn myself, I know that his lectures on Churchill will teach you more about this subject than any of the many books and videos available to you, and they will reveal profound lessons that can be applied to the urgent problems of today. [](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zl38h9t920hp1n35sr1pb2a2scm6a1anl5llio18_rp22sh2s8i66pb7c9i66o72cdh2bs) Only a limited number of these DVD sets are available, so I hope you’ll take this opportunity to add it to your personal library or give it as a gift—before they’re gone. Here’s a secure link to reserve your copy of **“Winston Churchill and Statesmanship** ” on DVD: _[**https://secure.hillsdale.edu/winston-churchill-dvd-offer/**](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2z88gq31b6i9jrmpk0jf6cutauuo3s2gmn9ohh3vo_rp22sh2s8i66pb7c9i66o72cdh2bs)_ You’ll undoubtedly enjoy this close study of Churchill’s words and deeds.

Best regards,

Kyle Murnen, ‘09 Director of Online Learning Hillsdale College |

Fellow Patriot, My family escaped communist Vietnam after my father was put on a kill list. And even coming here as a child, I knew that I was a part of something special.

I know what happens when freedoms are taken for granted

I know what happens without the freedoms we have here, and that made me never take America for granted. So I decided to do something to defend the country that gave me everything.

That’s why I attended the Naval Academy and spent my career fighting alongside special operations to keep America safe. _Because without our military, our great country might not exist._

Our freedom is on the line with the midterms, and I know you will NEVER take our liberties for granted.

name: John Fetterman
subject: Sheetz > Wawa
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Maggie for NH |
body:
When I left Pennsylvania for grad school, I *never* envisioned myself ending up in public service
| | |
---
Friend,
I’m gonna talk about growing up in Pennsylvania, but first, I have to ask: **[Can you split $3 to help fund our General Election campaign and Maggie Hassan’s reelection? I’m *so* grateful for your support (even if you think Wawa > Sheetz).](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/47520848/354614854/1140246662?amounts=3,10,25,50,100&amount=3&refcode=mh-jtk1193-bu-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODg1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyZmI2OWY1MS0xZmZlLWVjMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=6R6fwrq0Qp7lwIlndaJ_AwJl_d9a1_eaMBvKodxC9Gc=) 🙄**
Ok, now onto the good stuff.

I was born in Reading, Pennsylvania when my parents were just two teenagers starting out on their own. I love my parents, even if Gisele is their favorite.

We started out struggling. My dad was a union grocery worker at ShopRite, working night shifts. The union way of life helped keep our family together while he went to college. Dad ended up graduating, and got a good job as an underwriter.

Peter, If it wasn’t for America, I don’t know if I'd be alive right now.

My family escaped communism in Vietnam and came to this great country as refugees.

My father was on the communist party’s kill list, but America welcomed him with open arms.

Once we got here, we were amazed - my parents didn’t even know the freedoms we have here were possible.

_But now, I’m horrified to see some of these freedoms being taken away by the radical Left._

I am forever in debt to America, and I won't let the country I owe my life to go down the same path as the communist horror I left behind.

My father was on the communist party’s kill list, but America welcomed him with open arms. Once we got here, we were amazed - my parents didn’t even know the freedoms we have here were possible. But now, I’m horrified to see some of these freedoms being taken away by the radical Left. I am forever in debt to America, and I won't let the country I owe my life to go down the same path as the communist horror I left behind. Growing up, I knew I owed everything to our great country, Peter. That’s why I attended the Naval Academy and served in the Navy for 25 years. Here’s what we’re doing to protect reproductive rights: |
# [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/47522279/354619851/823540626?refcode=ea.ca67dc69-26fe-ec11-b47a-281878b83d8a&ms=ea.ca67dc69-26fe-ec11-b47a-281878b83d8a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODE3NiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjYTY3ZGM2OS0yNmZlLWVjMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=g7wXVYtzyhWvglzsShwIuoOTZFbTFNoW09aJwkcHe2E=&emci=9f5fd3e3-03fe-ec11-b47a-281878b83d8a&emdi=ca67dc69-26fe-ec11-b47a-281878b83d8a&ceid=1049176)
The last several weeks have been devastating for many people across our country, Peter. After the Supreme Court ripped away the constitutional right to reproductive freedom, it’s now up to the states to determine whether women get reproductive health care. **And in North Carolina, they still can.** As Governor, I’m determined to keep it that way, but **[I need to ask you to split a donation between my team and the North Carolina Democratic Party to help in this fight.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/47522280/354619852/1976991193?refcode=ea.ca67dc69-26fe-ec11-b47a-281878b83d8a&ms=ea.ca67dc69-26fe-ec11-b47a-281878b83d8a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODE3NiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjYTY3ZGM2OS0yNmZlLWVjMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=g7wXVYtzyhWvglzsShwIuoOTZFbTFNoW09aJwkcHe2E=)** Yesterday, Planned Parenthood National President Alexis McGill Johnson joined me in Raleigh to discuss the critical need for continued access to these services, especially now that North Carolina is set to be one of the only states in our region where legal abortion is protected. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/47522281/354619853/1976991193?refcode=ea.ca67dc69-26fe-ec11-b47a-281878b83d8a&ms=ea.ca67dc69-26fe-ec11-b47a-281878b83d8a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODE3NiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjYTY3ZGM2OS0yNmZlLWVjMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=g7wXVYtzyhWvglzsShwIuoOTZFbTFNoW09aJwkcHe2E=) **I signed Executive Order 263 which takes action to help assure access to reproductive health services in North Carolina:**
* This Order will help protect North Carolina doctors and nurses and their patients from cruel, right-wing criminal laws passed by other states.
* It will help coordinate health care access.
* And it will help ensure that local police are enforcing our state law that prevents anyone from obstructing or barring access to a health care facility.

**Next, we need to elect pro-choice Democrats up and down the ballot this November. We cannot afford Republican supermajorities in Raleigh that would override my veto and push through an outright ban on abortion care.** Peter, re-electing people like Sydney Batch and Linda Cooper-Suggs and electing candidates like Val Applewhite, Mary Willis Bode, Valerie Jordan, Amy Block DeLoach, Laura Budd, and Christy Clark is critical. They are exactly the kinds of voices I need fighting alongside me in Raleigh. They’re committed to doing whatever it takes to keep abortion services legal and accessible in our state, and they will help hold the line against Republican control of our legislature. They’re also all up for election in November. **[By donating to our team and the North Carolina Democratic Party, you can directly and significantly impact their campaigns. | You know what makes me madder than adults that force kids to wear masks?
_When they do it behind your back—_

Case in point: The Scottsdale Unified School District (SUSD)...

In August of 2021, the then SUSD president, Jann-Michael Greenburg, tried hosting a school board meeting **without telling the parents about it...**

And then he tried implementing a new mask mandate at this meeting **for all Scottsdale students, even for young kindergarteners...**

Which explains why he hid the meeting from their parents.

That’s why I filed a lawsuit against the SUSD on June 20th for violating Arizona’s Open Meeting Law...

Which requires the school district to make school board meetings open to all parents.

I’m committed to making sure that you and your children _never have to wear a mask again..._

**And one of the reasons I’m running for the U.S. Senate is to make sure that we put these mask mandates to bed. PERIOD. **

Mask mandates across the nation have mostly gone by the wayside...

But it’s hard not to feel a little bit like this whole “easing up” thing from Democrats isn’t just because it’s election season.

They saw that they were on the wrong side of this political issue so they backed down (for now)...
But my fear is that if they can, they’ll bring them right back on Wednesday, November 9th (the day after the election).

Don’t believe me?

Just take a drive to Los Angeles, and you’ll be amazed by how many people are still wearing masks.
They forced you to mask up before... and they’re ready to pounce again.

But if you send me to the United States Senate, I’ll fight hard to make sure that never happens.

Sincerely,
Mark

P.S. Still finding it strange that I’m not asking you for money in a lot of my emails? It’s because while donations are CRUCIAL in a hotly contested campaign like this, what’s even more important is earning your trust.

That, and good old-fashioned boots on the ground.

That’s right, volunteering is one of the most critical ways you can support my campaign and help us win the upcoming primary, and the General Election after that.

If you haven’t already**,**[**go here to check out volunteer opportunities with my campaign today...**](https://brnoforaz.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=f2832e79a2cd8992eddbf352a&id=2901a09188&e=6dcd2506d1)

And let’s fight together to keep Arizona free.

clean_body: | | | | You know what makes me madder than adults that force kids to wear masks? When they do it behind your back— Case in point: The Scottsdale Unified School District (SUSD)... In August of 2021, the then SUSD president, Jann-Michael Greenburg, tried hosting a school board meeting without telling the parents about it... And then he tried implementing a new mask mandate at this meeting for all Scottsdale students, even for young kindergarteners... Which explains why he hid the meeting from their parents. That’s why I filed a lawsuit against the SUSD on June 20th for violating Arizona’s Open Meeting Law... Which requires the school district to make school board meetings open to all parents. I’m committed to making sure that you and your children never have to wear a mask again... And one of the reasons I’m running for the U.S. Senate is to make sure that we put these mask mandates to bed. PERIOD. Mask mandates across the nation have mostly gone by the wayside... But it’s hard not to feel a little bit like this whole “easing up” thing from Democrats isn’t just because it’s election season. They saw that they were on the wrong side of this political issue so they backed down (for now)... But my fear is that if they can, they’ll bring them right back on Wednesday, November 9th (the day after the election). Don’t believe me? Just take a drive to Los Angeles, and you’ll be amazed by how many people are still wearing masks. They forced you to mask up before... and they’re ready to pounce again. But if you send me to the United States Senate, I’ll fight hard to make sure that never happens. Sincerely, Mark P.S. Still finding it strange that I’m not asking you for money in a lot of my emails? It’s because while donations are CRUCIAL in a hotly contested campaign like this, what’s even more important is earning your trust. That, and good old-fashioned boots on the ground. That’s right, volunteering is one of the most critical ways you can support my campaign and help us win the upcoming primary, and the General Election after that. | | Now that the Supreme Court has overturned _Roe v. Wade,_ the Senate must act swiftly to codify _Roe_ into law and safeguard access to safe, legal abortion nationwide. Ron Wyden has made it clear that he will never stop fighting for the reproductive rights of every single American. But as abortion is already being criminalized in states nationwide in the wake of this Supreme Court ruling, Ron's message about data privacy is more urgent than ever. Protecting the right to online privacy has become a life or death matter in the United States. **Protecting Americans' data is critical so that the phone records, search history, fertility app data, and more cannot be weaponized against women who seek out abortions or reproductive care.** Ron is fighting tooth and nail to safeguard abortion information online and the right to privacy. **[Now more than ever, we need fighters like Ron in the Senate. Will you chip in $3 now?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/47523006/354623206/-2044921950?refcode=2022-07-07-privacyfwd&recurring=0&amount=3&amounts=10,30,50,100,200&refcode2=754a7dda-27fe-ec11-b47a-281878b83d8a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDEvMS84OTQxMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3NTRhN2RkYS0yN2ZlLWVjMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=8Q4546qDZAQm1fEa_IIxxqklDyVSMOHkg70A_nsCqjo=)** _Team Wyden_ Forwarded Message | [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/47523007/354623207/2140832878?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDEvMS84OTQxMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3NTRhN2RkYS0yN2ZlLWVjMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=8Q4546qDZAQm1fEa_IIxxqklDyVSMOHkg70A_nsCqjo=&emci=36ed57e7-03f8-ec11-b47a-281878b83d8a&emdi=754a7dda-27fe-ec11-b47a-281878b83d8a&ceid=9818364)

If the Supreme Court overturns _Roe v. Wade_ , it will have far-reaching consequences for half of America.
**People across the country will lose access to abortion or have it severely limited** as Republicans pursue a nationwide abortion ban.
**Anti-choice extremists aren't just seeking to ban abortions; they're trying to**** _criminalize_****them.** And Republicans are already working on grotesque measures to punish health care providers and patients seeking care.
**And believe it or not, it gets worse.** If _Roe_ is overturned, a woman's private information – from researching birth control online to bringing a phone to the doctor's office to entering information into a period tracking app – could be used as evidence to prosecute them.
This should alarm us all. If the Supreme Court follows through and overturns _Roe_ , **every digital record could be weaponized to control women's bodies and criminalize people for seeking abortions.**
We need to do _everything_ in our power to ensure that reproductive rights are protected now and into the future.
That's why I'm working to pass legislation that would stop shady data brokers from becoming a deadly tool for far-right prosecutors who want to stick their noses into huge databases of Americans' private information. Including persecuting a woman for getting essential reproductive health care, including an abortion.
Let me be clear: this is a once-in-a-generation fight for the fundamental right to live your life free of government intrusion. I'm going to continue fighting tooth and nail to safeguard Americans' constitutional right to privacy once and for all.
The radical right is pressing its advantage in the courts, working all the angles to threaten women's bodily autonomy. But this movement – you and me and millions of pro-choice activists like us – must keep fighting, through every avenue, to protect every American's right to reproductive health care. I'm in this fight. Please join me.
_Ron_

The radical right is pressing its advantage in the courts, working all the angles to threaten women's bodily autonomy. Peter Lumaj

name: Tim Ryan
subject: the longest email I’ll ever send
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Tim Ryan for Ohio
body:
[ https://act.timforoh.com/go/46?t=1001&akid=4501%2E3611125%2E9tdrFV ][IMG]

This is the longest email I’ll ever send you, so I hope you’ll read the
whole thing.

I want to share our game plan for flipping Ohio’s open Senate seat
blue—when you’re running in a swing state that Trump won, you can’t leave
anything to chance.

That’s why I have to ask: [ https://act.timforoh.com/go/16202?t=1009&amount=25&akid=4501%2E3611125%2E9tdrFV ]Will you make a $25 donation to help us on
the road to victory to flip Ohio blue and expand our Democratic Senate
majority?

[ https://act.timforoh.com/go/16202?t=1010&amount=25&akid=4501%2E3611125%2E9tdrFV ]Chip in

--------------------------------------------------------------------------

Step One: Talk to Folks in Every Corner of Ohio

Working class Ohioans, in our big cities and our small towns, know what
it’s like to be left out and left behind. I won’t be that kind of Senator.

We kicked off this campaign by launching a Workers First Tour. Since then,
we’ve been traveling all over Ohio—visiting union halls, factories,
restaurants, and even a few bars—to hear from folks about the challenges
they’re facing.

The truth is, a lot of people don’t trust politicians, and they have every
reason to be skeptical. The only way to break through that is to look
someone in the eye, shake their hand, and let them see that you don’t have
eight heads.

The opposition might be spending millions of dollars to attack me, but
your donations allow me to do what matters—show up and meet folks
face-to-face.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------

Step Two: Stand Up to Special Interests and Put Workers First

I’ve made more than a few headlines for getting loud (okay, outright
yelling) on the House floor, because when it comes to speaking up for the
hardworking people out there busting their rear ends every day, I’ll never
hold my tongue.

Whether it’s the Chinese government, Big Pharma, a corporate giant trying
to ship jobs overseas, or a member of my own party—I’m not afraid to take
on anyone who tries to leave our workers high and dry.

If that puts a target on my back, so be it.

My Republican opponent JD Vance can rely on the steady support of
dark-money groups, but I’m proud to run a campaign that’s powered by
grassroots supporters like you—not right-wing special interests and tech
billionaires.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------

Step Three: Focus On The Issues That Matter

The vast majority of Americans are working harder and longer, making less,
and falling further behind. CEOs are getting golden parachutes, while our
seniors are cutting pills in half because they can’t afford their
medications.

You wouldn’t know it from listening to JD Vance though—all he does is yell
about the culture war du jour. We’re not going to flip Ohio blue and
expand our Democratic majority by starting fights over Big Bird and Dr.
Seuss—we need to stay focused on the issues that matter.

It doesn’t matter if I’m talking to a Democrat, Independent, or
Republican—I’m talking about jobs and wages. I’m talking about making Ohio
a manufacturing powerhouse. Lowering the cost of prescription drugs.
Expanding broadband access. Making sure our kids get a good education.

Vance is trying to make this race about anger, division, and fear because
he knows that when it comes down to the issues that actually make a
difference for working families, he’ll lose every time.

That’s why my team has to send you emails like this one—so we’ll have the
resources to get our message out over all his GOP nonsense.

I’m giving this race everything I’ve got, but I can’t win this thing
alone. [ https://act.timforoh.com/go/16202?t=1011&amount=25&akid=4501%2E3611125%2E9tdrFV ]I’m personally asking you to rush a donation of $25 so we can
carry out our campaign strategy, flip Ohio blue, and finally cut workers
in on the deal.

[ https://act.timforoh.com/go/16202?t=1012&amount=25&akid=4501%2E3611125%2E9tdrFV ]Donate $25 [ https://act.timforoh.com/go/16202?t=1013&amount=50&akid=4501%2E3611125%2E9tdrFV ]Donate $50

Thanks for your support,

Tim

body:
We must celebrate democracy, even in dark times | | | Hi Peter – I hope you had a wonderful July 4th holiday weekend. I drove to Montana to help out Democratic congressional nominee Monica Tranel and made sure to see some fireworks along the way. While we were marching in the Fourth of July parade, I was reminded why we must celebrate our democracy, even in dark times.****[**_We're on a mission to save our democracy – will you chip in $5 or more HERE to help us meet that goal?_**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/wehEm_vu1NBVXOKYSqOxTOi34aJoCJC1EivM7Ih953xNG6r6b6yi4Uz9vCRXD2Gc0zZXQuP5iaFLRM2K0eGWMqVH99D0EGxIRcOsTW5FPYiHZRer-fyRHsVcGki6CuqIBgcZhUXPB3-uZb4WHjMXRfhIeGZ9c6CU7u3G5eIuUEUeJ_B-RzPqnngW7cdOFJvK1Em9va8BVLNxHmzCWx61MgyjletZhdFCl3VFtaS0eUToaCXuFwDf08IgE8eIo5ncXTRjIvCJEs62g6p8fmRKrFHGBAdodtCXq3qVM-2dlZnpWKVUWKkGo6YY5gkx-23IVWfw-MtZG3g5dIGLKnjT_5M8kq_huU2Cq40cxD3fyr9RInxUbMWjIfL7B98hIPmzgMyB9Q9zby8C6CQmnGn8-BJ0wevaMsKQyg3FRiFUqzHojzWXOa8Jaa7pL-Ixy5t1EabQCDSDyBqIyXWHc4q8DQ/3nj/Scgx4LXuT8S24XfA-EKbDA/h0/tTMT89G1ri4rT_crtWY1Oh8Csvd9oUdCh-d-up3Zmbs) As Thomas Paine wrote in 1776, "These are the times that try men's souls." You get to know a person when the going is easy, but you can learn even more from how they confront crises and hardship. **The truth is, Republicans have shown their true colors during hardship, and the results have been ugly.** Rural Americans know that what we really need are politicians who don't play games, but work to make our schools, economy, and resources work for every American. July 4th is a celebration, but it's also a reminder that the fight for freedom isn't easy. We are reminded that it won't be simple to weed out those who seek to make our country benefit their own individual gain. **But we are also reminded that democracy is worth fighting for, and that it requires all of us.** I wanted to thank you for your support, and for realizing that this next midterm election could very well change the future of our country. In these trying times, it will take everyone to make sure that democracy prevails. With thanks and appreciation. – Joe Shepherd

clean_body: We must celebrate democracy, even in dark times | | | Hi Peter – I hope you had a wonderful July 4th holiday weekend. I drove to Montana to help out Democratic congressional nominee Monica Tranel and made sure to see some fireworks along the way. While we were marching in the Fourth of July parade, I was reminded why we must celebrate our democracy, even in dark times.** As Thomas Paine wrote in 1776, "These are the times that try men's souls." You get to know a person when the going is easy, but you can learn even more from how they confront crises and hardship. The truth is, Republicans have shown their true colors during hardship, and the results have been ugly. Rural Americans know that what we really need are politicians who don't play games, but work to make our schools, economy, and resources work for every American. July 4th is a celebration, but it's also a reminder that the fight for freedom isn't easy. We are reminded that it won't be simple to weed out those who seek to make our country benefit their own individual gain. But we are also reminded that democracy is worth fighting for, and that it requires all of us. I wanted to thank you for your support, and for realizing that this next midterm election could very well change the future of our country. In these trying times, it will take everyone to make sure that democracy prevails. With thanks and appreciation. – Joe Shepherd United Rural Democrats (URD) is leading the effort to rebuild the Democratic Party in rural America. If we're going to take back our country, we need a 50-state strategy to organize in every community across the country. Will you support our network of activists on the ground as we work to rebuild our party's infrastructure and flip these areas blue?

name: Trudy Busch Valentine
subject: I'm devastated, but I will always continue to fight
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Trudy Busch Valentine for Senate
body:
I believe with my whole heart that we should all be in charge of what happens to our bodies.
| | |
---
Peter, I believe with my whole heart that we should all be in charge of what happens to our bodies.
The Supreme Court's decision to overturn Roe v. Wade has taken away a right that we have counted on for nearly 50 years. Before Roe, folks were prosecuted or even jailed for seeking abortions. Others died from the often unsafe and dangerous procedures that were forced to happen behind closed doors. People would travel across city limits, state lines, and even national borders to receive the care they needed.
**With this new ruling, that's the world we're heading back to. **Partisan extremists will have the power to restrict reproductive freedoms. They could ban interstate travel to receive abortion care. They could incarcerate patients, their doctors, and their nurses. They could criminalize just the very act of seeking information about abortions. They could even ban abortion nationwide.
**But this isn't just about abortion. It is about protecting women’s autonomy, their power to make their own decisions, and their equality.**
The Court's ruling is devastating, it's ruthless, and it goes against our Constitution's tenets of liberty and equality for all. I refuse to accept that this is our future. We must give people the capacity to think for themselves, to choose their own futures, to control their own bodies.
As a nurse and a mom, I know that our country must provide compassionate and good care for everyone – that includes contraception and the right to an abortion. **As senator, you have my word that I will work night and day to pass legislation that codifies Roe v. Wade into law and restore the reproductive freedoms that we've counted on for generations.**
The majority of Americans are with us on this. But powerful forces are bankrolling a vocal, radical minority – and right now, they're winning. **We must unite together to make our voices heard today and at the polls in November.[So please, can I count on you to make a grassroots donation to support my campaign and stand for reproductive freedom? clean_body: I believe with my whole heart that we should all be in charge of what happens to our bodies. | | | Peter, I believe with my whole heart that we should all be in charge of what happens to our bodies. The Supreme Court's decision to overturn Roe v. Wade has taken away a right that we have counted on for nearly 50 years. Before Roe, folks were prosecuted or even jailed for seeking abortions. Others died from the often unsafe and dangerous procedures that were forced to happen behind closed doors. People would travel across city limits, state lines, and even national borders to receive the care they needed. With this new ruling, that's the world we're heading back to. Partisan extremists will have the power to restrict reproductive freedoms. They could ban interstate travel to receive abortion care. They could incarcerate patients, their doctors, and their nurses. They could criminalize just the very act of seeking information about abortions. They could even ban abortion nationwide. But this isn't just about abortion. It is about protecting women’s autonomy, their power to make their own decisions, and their equality. The Court's ruling is devastating, it's ruthless, and it goes against our Constitution's tenets of liberty and equality for all. I refuse to accept that this is our future. We must give people the capacity to think for themselves, to choose their own futures, to control their own bodies. As a nurse and a mom, I know that our country must provide compassionate and good care for everyone – that includes contraception and the right to an abortion. As senator, you have my word that I will work night and day to pass legislation that codifies Roe v. Wade into law and restore the reproductive freedoms that we've counted on for generations. The majority of Americans are with us on this. But powerful forces are bankrolling a vocal, radical minority – and right now, they're winning. body:
Hello Faithful Volunteers!

Here's an update on what is happening in District 4.

_Orange County Volunteers:_
Volunteer Gathering for Training BREAKFAST PROVIDED!
Date: This Saturday, July 9
Time: 9:30am
Place: Rusty and Sonya Tolins house (Courtney's parents) 1314 Still Brook Place, Hillsborough
Please attend and bring a potential volunteer!!

_Durham GOP FUNDRAISER featuring Courtney Geels - For ALL county volunteers!_
Date: Sunday, July 17
Time: 1:30 - 4:30pm
Place: Devine Sports Bar, 904 W. Main Street in Durham
RSVP: <https://durham.nc.gop/events> _Click on the date_
Please attend and bring potential supporters! This is an opportunity for you in place of hosting a Meet & Greet!

You can always check Courtney's website for events here: <https://courtneygeelsforcongress.com/events/>

_ONGOING NEEDS:_
_**Please recruit at least one volunteer!_ It will help us reach our goal to have every polling location covered on November 8. Have them sign up here:
<https://courtneygeelsforcongress.com/volunteer/>

**_We need 987 more people to set up a**monthly recurring gift** of $22 or more from now through November!_ Ask friends, family, even out-of-staters who care about the direction of our country. EVERY STATE MATTERS!
Sign up here: <https://secure.winred.com/courtney-geels-for-congress/donate-today>

**_We need people to call inconsistent Republican voters through the end of July to confirm they will be voting this November!_ The more we call, the less we need to target by door-knocking and the more time we all save. Lists, scripts and training available. Please respond to this email if you have **not** gotten a sheet of Republicans to call, or if you already finished your list and are ready for more!!

_LAST BUT NOT LEAST!_
**Please mark your calendars for early voting October 20- November 5, and Election Day November 8th. We need all hands on deck. If you are able to take off work on November 8th, we need a _minimum of 322 volunteers on election day_. If you are RETIRED OR FLEXIBLE WITH YOUR TIME and are able to do a 2-3 hour shift at your favorite early voting location every day, that is extremely helpful!! We will start scheduling soon. **
**
**
If you prefer to volunteer in your county, contact your County Director:

_Person_ : Daniel Poole - [poole_christian@yahoo.com](mailto:poole_christian@yahoo.com)
_Orange_ : LaRayne Quale - [LaRayne@courtneygeelsforcongress.com](mailto:LaRayne@courtneygeelsforcongress.com)
_Alamance_ : Corrie Shepherd - [Corrieshep@gmail.com](mailto:Corrieshep@gmail.com)
_Durham_ : Renee Hill - [rhill632@aol.com](mailto:rhill632@aol.com)
_Granville_ : Ron & Barb Conway - [rb_conway@msn.com](mailto:rb_conway@msn.com); [ron_conway@msn.com](mailto:ron_conway@msn.com)

__Fighting for Truth, Justice and Unity Together!__

Laurie Teper
Volunteer Coordinator
Courtney Geels for Congress NC04
Email: [volunteers@courtneygeelsforcongress.com](mailto:volunteers@courtneygeelsforcongress.com)
Cell: (847)212-5651

name: Rep. Dana Criswell
subject: Gunn Supports Liberal Democrat
body:
Mississippi Freedom Caucus Calls on Gunn and White to Disavow Liberal Shanda Yates A news story first reported by Frank Corder at Y'all Politics was released earlier today which indicates that Rep | |
---

| | | Mississippi Freedom Caucus Calls on Gunn and White to Disavow Liberal Shanda Yates |
---|---|---
| A news story first reported by Frank Corder at [Y'all Politics](https://www.votervoice.net/BroadcastLinks/80xw_H0wr4FtjJ6Og8qe3w) was released earlier today which indicates that Republican Speaker of the House Philip Gunn and former-Democrat turned Republican Speaker Pro Tem Jason White are fundraising for former-Democrat Representative Shanda Yates. Yates, who beat out a long-time Republican Bill Denny, ran under a far-left-progressive platform and was supported by the Sister District Project and former Bill Clinton appointed U.S. Secretary of Agriculture Mike Espy. The Sister District Project's website indicates their organization aims "to build enduring progressive power in state legislatures." In an interview during her campaign, Yates indicated that she hoped to "break the Republican supermajority in our state" but now seems to be supported by the Republicans she so passionately wants to remove from power. The Jackson Free Press reported after her election win that "Unlike other Democrats trying to unseat [Republican] incumbents, Yates did not try to run as a conservative Democrat." Yates also indicated during her campaign that "I believe that the six-week abortion ban is unconstitutional and will be overturned."
[Click Here to send Message to Speaker Gunn and Pro-Tem White](https://www.votervoice.net/MSFreedomCaucus/Campaigns/96193/Respond) During her time in the Legislature, Yates has authored bills to remove the prohibition on same-sex marriage, allow gay couples to adopt children, allow for early voting and online voter registration, and several bills to expand Medicaid. Yates has also voted against pro-life bills and against the Fairness Act which prevents males from playing female sports. Yates clearly ran as a liberal Democrat, has continued her political career in the legislature as a liberal, and indicated in an interview with WLBT upon leaving the Democratic Party to be an independent that her politics and goals had not changed, only the letter behind her name. This is certainly a new low for the Republican leadership in the Mississippi Legislature to help fundraise for a legislator that holds such extreme liberal views. The Mississippi Freedom Caucus calls on Speaker Gunn and Speaker Pro Tem White to disavow Shanda Yates and immediately cancel all efforts to raise money for her re-election. The Mississippi Freedom Caucus will never turn our state back to our true conservative views of individual liberty, faith, and strong families. Yet as long as Republicans at the top of our party are actively fundraising for the most extreme liberals in the state, how do we ever expect true conservatives to have a chance at getting elected?_###_[**Click Here to Join Call for Gunn to Disavow Liberal Yates**](https://www.votervoice.net/MSFreedomCaucus/Campaigns/96193/Respond) |
|

The Jackson Free Press reported after her election win that "Unlike other Democrats trying to unseat [Republican] incumbents, Yates did not try to run as a conservative Democrat." Yates also indicated during her campaign that "I believe that the six-week abortion ban is unconstitutional and will be overturned." During her time in the Legislature, Yates has authored bills to remove the prohibition on same-sex marriage, allow gay couples to adopt children, allow for early voting and online voter registration, and several bills to expand Medicaid. Yates has also voted against pro-life bills and against the Fairness Act which prevents males from playing female sports. Yates clearly ran as a liberal Democrat, has continued her political career in the legislature as a liberal, and indicated in an interview with WLBT upon leaving the Democratic Party to be an independent that her politics and goals had not changed, only the letter behind her name. This is certainly a new low for the Republican leadership in the Mississippi Legislature to help fundraise for a legislator that holds such extreme liberal views. The Mississippi Freedom Caucus calls on Speaker Gunn and Speaker Pro Tem White to disavow Shanda Yates and immediately cancel all efforts to raise money for her re-election. The Mississippi Freedom Caucus will never turn our state back to our true conservative views of individual liberty, faith, and strong families. Yet as long as Republicans at the top of our party are actively fundraising for the most extreme liberals in the state, how do we ever expect true conservatives to have a chance at getting elected?###_ | | * | The Caucus is a political organization dedicated to promoting the ideals of individual rights, limited government and free enterprise within the state of Mississippi. | Mississippi Freedom Caucus 530 George Street, Suite 200 Jackson, MS 39202 www.FreedomCaucus.ms 662-469-6242 info@freedomcaucus.ms ---|--- You are currently subscribed to a mailing list of Mississippi Freedom Caucus. The video then [shows](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001XOCsV5cAtKMG-GM1rDovf4qQnnVbG5YdamDJtDO_ojK6mxrbOsdg4slu-GMlvVT3lSkZPk9SYK1dFz27cuMXY-kX7Ey4OvXYPRZxqfjZRRftUECZmC5tGuaAvCjHYE7ZMrekiDFl85teEFrSlEFzHDsencz-dwFtYktOBzM7C1jWor5xmmM9XwuanVHvUlyWtsYZ9SyjrvrTPkx4zbBprV6ea7kwezKMEbCj39n4aj7lhIlg1KJ_B6hCcjPVndcinkGdhJiwbiYSB6JGFTFQGFn14zt0WdG_&c=ZzCTJell_rNdJJM95Ye5Y8xYWoSsHmmVygpBj4n1ezvEw0O8ZyD4OA==&ch=NjgM3Zlml0ZrkdpVHGC9lACiEvsQhzhPqsJWx99IoflsO2PWtQxXSQ==) part of an ad from the former Navy SEAL officer's 2016 gubernatorial campaign, where he says, "I'm no career politician... and I'll take dead aim at politics as usual." He then opens fire, causing an explosion.
---
| [ ](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001XOCsV5cAtKMG-GM1rDovf4qQnnVbG5YdamDJtDO_ojK6mxrbOsdg4slu-GMlvVT3oPOi4mxmwhPaD4fn4sqrgKWHEy12MNrNyDs3OALUCzXGN8vXyuuS3bpFuVPN2YzeYYlgt1sABxS84waOWpp_lg==&c=ZzCTJell_rNdJJM95Ye5Y8xYWoSsHmmVygpBj4n1ezvEw0O8ZyD4OA==&ch=NjgM3Zlml0ZrkdpVHGC9lACiEvsQhzhPqsJWx99IoflsO2PWtQxXSQ==)

| After the flashback, Greitens is seen walking through a field while carrying his rifle.
"Everyone also remembers, because I fought for you, they came after me. Well, we're back - wiser, stronger, still fighting - and this time with an army of patriots," he says as three people in Ghillie suits emerge from the ground. The America First candidate then shoots his rifle resulting in another large blast.
Greitens's latest video follows a June 20 ad that metaphorically [talked](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001XOCsV5cAtKMG-GM1rDovf4qQnnVbG5YdamDJtDO_ojK6mxrbOsdg4slu-GMlvVT30LhTE02PTqzdKr-pasyhQxy8Je52mbpjEdrco1rdnWZ_0NfacXhpyAq0WcuzHBsQHII7kZpFFxJeYUZgrrBRZCXhERfTW8qKvJI0hNX5T2awFjjYJhu200789P5gbiEEh5XkRGXVc5n5gdo4xqUKpPeQvCh8F_YUgVY5KDDoxlFVRH5KysgnQ_Iuw7oi4vW5NBLbnxHi2Cw=&c=ZzCTJell_rNdJJM95Ye5Y8xYWoSsHmmVygpBj4n1ezvEw0O8ZyD4OA==&ch=NjgM3Zlml0ZrkdpVHGC9lACiEvsQhzhPqsJWx99IoflsO2PWtQxXSQ==) about "hunting RINOs" or Republicans in Name Only, which drew criticism from the political establishment and mainstream media, suggesting the ad was to be taken in a literal sense.
"Today, we're going RINO hunting," says Greitens in the ad while holding a shotgun. "The RINO feeds on corruption, and is marked by the stripes of cowardice."
Facebook and Twitter ultimately blacklisted the advertisement, but not before some 1.5 million Americans saw it, he told Breitbart News.
"If anyone doesn't get the metaphor, they are either lying or dumb," said Greitens campaign manager Dylan Johnson.
"Patriots around the country are loving it because we're making a very clear message that we do need to take on RINOs, and we talk about their corruption, we talk about their cowardice, and absolutely we have also upset the left," Greitens [told](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001XOCsV5cAtKMG-GM1rDovf4qQnnVbG5YdamDJtDO_ojK6mxrbOsdg4slu-GMlvVT3aW5hDp2V9iSiAWVRz4ZEZnIuf7cFCui2A6q9IncO8bMrFRMqU9SrkuhSylm96Dpc7AQB8kUyoGD4Ns63Zmp2MnZ3GO5ZRNo1xMwfhcEgXvBcpTMwViwLgRA_CK9clnuf-jTzW3cSbqiAY9HYkaiQEpRxW28EySs4aiWJpsNal27m-1JBV7KSI_sTFYTFFv4gXTrLTbFnyz28pd3k-2a85wCGFAkFlp2VWocwwBGReB2qc0BfrN40Fw==&c=ZzCTJell_rNdJJM95Ye5Y8xYWoSsHmmVygpBj4n1ezvEw0O8ZyD4OA==&ch=NjgM3Zlml0ZrkdpVHGC9lACiEvsQhzhPqsJWx99IoflsO2PWtQxXSQ==) Breitbart News Saturday of the ad. "It's not just the left with their tyranny and their crazy ideas and their attacks on the country that have put us in crisis, and it's not just the mainstream media and their lies," he said earlier in the interview.
"It's also RINOs, because of their corruption and their cowardice, that have created this crisis. RINOs who stab President Trump in the back, RINOs who stab the American people in the back, RINOs who failed on election integrity, RINOs who failed to pass a border wall, RINOs who supported Joe Biden's $1.2 trillion Green New Deal, and RINOs just this past week who sold out America on the Second Amendment. People are sick of RINOs."
FiveThirtyEight [projects](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001XOCsV5cAtKMG-GM1rDovf4qQnnVbG5YdamDJtDO_ojK6mxrbOsdg4vKFD1vpsBqOav7WhEpMlAaHUZ0V2_deVbb4ox_EhX1HuCszfTwnCDVF3idkxTMcVFNyqN6bOIopf7xbrJzZVylAweBrUNJY7TlhGvWu04fw8MdX-RozPDqZPOggjtO2Lk18r8JUaycYjY8SccoFGeTRzDYEAPbkIYYtJ3K_Vs0_&c=ZzCTJell_rNdJJM95Ye5Y8xYWoSsHmmVygpBj4n1ezvEw0O8ZyD4OA==&ch=NjgM3Zlml0ZrkdpVHGC9lACiEvsQhzhPqsJWx99IoflsO2PWtQxXSQ==) Greitens, who has also [launched](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001XOCsV5cAtKMG-GM1rDovf4qQnnVbG5YdamDJtDO_ojK6mxrbOsdg4slu-GMlvVT3A2HSJZFD4XvqZuP0P6oI182lzdqrMpVDmtgwrXQ66Hv-luxu7B-SsgcW--wlW1d4WctCHLAcQ0zydYuQq8CR1Oa9JKJ7CEutAU_vJd3yCcIyVy1lGx738emDdzyvFC8qBJLuDlGYND0zROOpNfB9SEw9l37CqqAixS7RgYzCp2zFVzduC6G5zApsm8Rl0IfMwvIxjME66DkTPrcsYuEiHW23KNYqkMOi-ypYG4uiJhM=&c=ZzCTJell_rNdJJM95Ye5Y8xYWoSsHmmVygpBj4n1ezvEw0O8ZyD4OA==&ch=NjgM3Zlml0ZrkdpVHGC9lACiEvsQhzhPqsJWx99IoflsO2PWtQxXSQ==) a "No MO RINO's" statewide tour, will prevail in the primary over Rep. Vicky Hartzler (R-MO) and Missouri attorney general Eric Schmitt, among other candidates, and face off against its projected Democrat nominee Lucas Kunce in the general election. **Our country is currently facing a great threat.** A new enemy has emerged from the shadows that seeks to destroy and intimidate their way to a transformed state, and country, that you and I would hardly recognize.
This enemy is the radical vigilante woke mob that will steamroll anything and anyone in their way. Their blatant attacks on the American way of life are clear and intensifying: _stifling dissent, public shaming, rampant violence, and a perverted version of history._
A group that will, literally, tear down monuments and buildings but -- perhaps in an even more sinister way -- tear down the American spirit itself. **They go after the family unit, parental rights, traditional moral values, the church, and fact-based education.**
Over the past few years, we've watched horrified as this group has attempted to _**brainwash our children**_ into thinking we live in an evil, racist, irredeemable country.
We listened to them deny science and data to exert political theater all the while _**trampling over personal liberties enshrined in the Constitution.**_

We watched _**Big Tech moguls in Silicon Valley be the arbiters of truth**_ - deciding who gets to speak and who gets silenced through the digital public square.
We listened to the legacy media muffle legitimately verifiable news stories that didn't align with their preferred narrative, only to watch the truth trickle out months later at a more politically expedient time.
**Well,****Peter****, the time for listening and watching from the sidelines is over.**
[**> >> FIGHT BACK <<<**](http://links.stoppingsocialistdems.com/u/click?_t=4dcc2aab65fd4d0da6a107b0eef86d43&_m=3ead00a131ee4dfd9221d4e76047b5bf&_e=pO4VKk8aMx16GMMXfJUvBO2TZkv0RdtsFyQuIkTIemNegh_9If6lCTupXVhAanYhb7JdTfFMs_zfRsVfyLek5E2Ibli6948q7RDKnN1QTAvAKz0IZF4eSKmrIoqBrtfg8aSQuvno5vFR2bvEwaz046oK8BYgIPPaa-oweBxU4ALsGAax-zphvhXvgEW4KLtmvDNsjz48vrB0LCpqz2W9zE0qdvKU2w2wz5rmK4aF3QTl_M6-AT2eSyA-EfxpoS9HgHb-WHku7u724RPwwGmT8ZfxhK5SJUjct_mEenVYbzvgYyoe6NEdKTtGoPdwCgiTbz2wTnwvdFTnwLifYIBMCGMeMNfZ65u8NXPVHAmq__ge6fya7bWAadEvgeQ22PsL6as8UgcAgX-FpbCgl736cA%3D%3D)
This enemy has taken over media, educational institutions, corporate boards, professional sports, foundations, and professional institutions. They have left no corner of our lives untouched. But all hope is not lost.
**We The People still have a say.** We know the truth, you and I, about America and the country she is and can be. We must fight to defeat these false pretenses and predetermined narratives.
**I am choosing to counter this enemy with faith, with reason, and with freedom. As Governor of the Free State of Florida, I have chosen to lead with a vision that builds America up rather than tears it down.**

clean_body: Peter, Our country is currently facing a great threat. A new enemy has emerged from the shadows that seeks to destroy and intimidate their way to a transformed state, and country, that you and I would hardly recognize. This enemy is the radical vigilante woke mob that will steamroll anything and anyone in their way. Their blatant attacks on the American way of life are clear and intensifying: stifling dissent, public shaming, rampant violence, and a perverted version of history. A group that will, literally, tear down monuments and buildings but -- perhaps in an even more sinister way -- tear down the American spirit itself. They go after the family unit, parental rights, traditional moral values, the church, and fact-based education. Over the past few years, we've watched horrified as this group has attempted to brainwash our children into thinking we live in an evil, racist, irredeemable country. We listened to them deny science and data to exert political theater all the while trampling over personal liberties enshrined in the Constitution. We saw them take to the streets for an entire summer like outlaws burning, looting, and destroying everything in sight while being told they were "mostly peaceful" and "passionate." We watched Big Tech moguls in Silicon Valley be the arbiters of truth - deciding who gets to speak and who gets silenced through the digital public square. We listened to the legacy media muffle legitimately verifiable news stories that didn't align with their preferred narrative, only to watch the truth trickle out months later at a more politically expedient time. Well,Peter, the time for listening and watching from the sidelines is over. This enemy has taken over media, educational institutions, corporate boards, professional sports, foundations, and professional institutions. They have left no corner of our lives untouched. But all hope is not lost. We The People still have a say. We know the truth, you and I, about America and the country she is and can be. We must fight to defeat these false pretenses and predetermined narratives. I am choosing to counter this enemy with faith, with reason, and with freedom. As Governor of the Free State of Florida, I have chosen to lead with a vision that builds America up rather than tears it down. Together we can ensure that our children are raised to know they live in the greatest state in the nation, the greatest country in the world and that they have an opportunity to continue making them even greater. Peter,

_The Seattle Times_ endorsed Derek Kilmer for Congress!

Derek is honored to be recognized for his work serving Washington's 6th as a problem solver who gets things done for the folks across our state.

As a Port Angeles native, Derek is guided by his roots in the community that shaped him and guides his work in Congress. He'll continue fighting to protect our natural resources, help our economy recover from the pandemic, ensure affordable healthcare, and defend fundamental reproductive rights.

Listen, Derek will never stop putting the people first - not just those in our district and state - but all Americans. The August primary is less than a month away, and it's clear that there's a lot at stake in this election - including our fundamental rights. We must ensure Derek has the resources needed to build another winning campaign and keep fighting for the people.

Here's the bottom line: Derek believes that endorsements aren't just about who stands with you - they're about who you stand with. Many candidates talk about going to bat for workers, our environment, seniors, families, and equality. Derek is proud that folks, leaders, and organizations across the region - and now _The Seattle Times_ - trust him to fight for progress every day.

_The Seattle Times_ wrote: "Voters in the 6th District should make the clear sensible choice to continue leading a deeply divided political realm back from the extremes."

We agree. **[If you're with Derek in the fight to get the government working for the people again, please stand with our campaign. | | With election results officially certified in Los Angeles County, we want to thank all our volunteers for their tireless efforts in supporting our campaign.
---
| |
---
| | While we did not make the top two outright, we are proud of the work we did to ensure that our communities had a say in this election. A true representative democracy means having the best candidates make it to the top two, not just the candidates who have the most money or political favors to cash in. Unfortunately, in this race, the candidates with the most resources, not the most qualified or community focused, won. This is unacceptable. That is why, after much consideration, we have decided to move forward with our campaign as a write-in candidate for the 2022 general election. In order for Southeast LA to have fair representation, we need leaders who understand the everyday struggles of all constituents. We need leaders who are in this fight for the right reasons, not to advance their own political careers. We need leaders who will stand up for what is right, especially when establishment Democrats fail to act on important issues like passing immigration reform, protecting reproductive rights, canceling all student loan debt, saving our planet, and providing much needed economic relief to working class families. We aren't naive. We know this will be an uphill battle, but like our community, we are resilient and we will persevere. We, la gente, will be the ones who decide who represents us. And as always, we will go forward con ganas y sin miedo. Nicole López

Standing with you,

Jeff

| | Folks, in our latest Civics for the Culture episode, host Chelsey Hall is back to finish the lesson about the history of our democracy. This time around, in Part Two of this series, Chelsey talks us through a brief, recent history of voting rights in America from the early 2000s to present day. As we reflect on what voting rights have looked like in our country, it’s hard to ignore that while we’ve made so much progress — so many things remain the same. There are still bad actors working to undo much of what we’ve accomplished. **And it’s never been more important to come together and exercise our right to vote.** [**This series is a part of our voter education program designed to give young people of color the resources they need to make their voices heard at the ballot box. Click here to watch our new Civics for the Culture episode and support voter education programs like this one.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/47528449/354647359/1245133222?refcode=em_20220707_f_f_cftc&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDMvMS84ODQ1MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3ODcwMjEyYS00MGZlLWVjMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=4AWK0rToFRoT8LTgYT_9Ty0I-yr6-xEkILGt1W8LNZQ=) After Black and brown voters turned out in historic numbers in 2020, we’ve seen almost every state attempt to pass anti-voter legislation, ranging from closing polling locations to purging voter rolls. **But we’re here to remind you that despite this, voting is still the most powerful tool that we have as Americans.** **And democracy is not a spectator sport.** While some states continue to introduce oppressive voter laws making it harder for Black and brown people to cast their ballots, on the other side of the coin **there are states leading the charge for voting rights**. States like California and Oregon have already passed automatic voter registration, and in places like Washington and Maine there is Election Day voter registration, allowing people to cast their ballot on the same day. **The work we’re doing is not in vain.** [**By voting, we’re sending a message that we want to make a more perfect union for generations to come. Team,

The Supreme Court’s relentless attacks on voting rights are already having a tangible impact on our democracy. Their decision in _Shelby_ spurred states with a history of discriminatory voting practices to immediately pass new laws restricting the right to vote. And now they may be coming after another section of the Voting Rights Act:
“Federal judges **threw out Alabama’s map** in the spring, but it was reinstated for 2022 by the Supreme Court, which ruled 5-4 that it was too close to the election to draw a new map. A federal judge in **Georgia** wrote in another case that the state’s map **may violate the Voting Rights Act** while letting it stand for 2022...”

_— POLITICO_
---
And team, this is only the beginning. If we don’t dig in our heels and fight with everything we’ve got to defend the right to vote and end GOP gerrymandering, **our democracy is in serious trouble**.

That’s why we’ve been working furiously to support Democrats running for office in districts and states on our list of Democracy Targets. So far, **we’re targeting races in 17 states** across the country, including state House seats, governor’s seats, secretary of state seats, and more. And that’s just one part of our plan!

We’ve been doing this work for years, and we’ve got a winning strategy — but we’re counting on supporters like you to help us keep going every step of the way. And with the midterms approaching fast, time is running short!

**If you can, please make a donation of any amount to the NDRC today and help us defend voting rights, end GOP gerrymandering, and preserve our democracy:**

Show your support for gun safety now.
#
Peter,
Each instance of gun violence is horrific — and it’s especially gut-wrenching so close to home.
Watching families flee from an active shooter at a Fourth of July parade is too much to bear.
I am working to make sure the Highland Park community has the federal support it needs.
Yes, we recently took a step forward by passing bipartisan legislation to reform our gun laws. But we all want to do more. And there is plenty of work left in the fight to end gun violence.
Nothing will bring back the loved ones we’ve lost. But we can honor their memories with action.
