Peter,
This past weekend, 13-year-old Rain Johnson was unlawfully detained for using a megaphone at an abortion rights protest in Lakeland.

And today, I cleared my schedule to join Rain at a Freedom to Choose rally in Lakeland — to make it clear that I stand with young people like Rain in the fight for a better, freer future.

Florida doesn’t have to be like this, and on November 8th, we have the chance to change it. That’s why I’ve officially launched our Election Day Fund to ensure we have the resources to get every last one of our supporters out to the polls and get their ballots counted. YOU will be the difference maker in these final weeks, Friend. My team has done the math – and between our GOTV efforts and grassroots outreach – for just $5.20, we’re making sure another one of our voters will get their ballot counted. We can’t become complacent in these final weeks. While I have no doubt we can and will surge ahead to victory on Election Day, getting there will require grit and determination. If we take our foot off the gas now, we’ll be giving our opponent the chance to seize the upper hand, and we’ll be giving radical liberal Tony Evers a free pass to reelection. That’s why I’m counting on the sustained support of grassroots conservatives like you now more than ever. With your help, we can maintain our momentum all the way through Election Day and ensure that each and every one of our supporters gets out to the polls and gets their ballot counted. Thank you, Rebecca Kleefisch Former Lieutenant Governor of Wisconsin Republican Candidate for Governor Paid for by People for Rebecca. PO Box 628284, Middleton, WI 53562

body:
Maggie Hassan has a tough race ahead of her for three big reasons
| | |
---
**Friend, Maggie Hassan has a tough race ahead of her for three big reasons:**
1\. The Senate is split 50-50, and the GOP needs to flip just ONE seat to take back control of the Senate.

2\. Political experts from _CNN_ to Rachel Maddow are reporting this seat in New Hampshire as one of the most likely to flip RED.

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/47523298/354624669/1144435635?refcode=nw_em_templateheader&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84ODM5MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmZmI1ZjE4NC0yOWZlLWVjMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=1sv7k82eAvFcp2ctObrhAg4x7zDmgux7fu0F6wkeIX0=)

Team,
When the Supreme Court overturned _Roe_ not even two weeks ago, we knew the consequences would be quick and devastating.
We were right. Already, people are being forced to travel out of state to access needed medical care. And as always, Mike DeWine responds with empty platitudes and refuses to acknowledge that _he caused this_ by signing Ohio’s draconian anti-abortion bill into law.
**[We cannot allow politicians like Governor DeWine and Republican leadership in the state legislature to determine what care people can receive, and as governor, I’ll fight to protect abortion rights. body:
BIG NEWS:

Assemblymember Robert Carroll (AD-44) endorses Dan Goldman for Congress

As a top supporter of this campaign, we want you to be amongst the first to know:

Dan Goldman just earned the endorsement of Assemblymember Robert Carroll, who represents a significant portion of the 10th district in the New York Assembly.

Here’s what Assemblymember Carroll had to say:

“With the National Republican Party set on dismantling democracy at the state and federal levels, we need a member of Congress who on day one has the skills and experience to fight back. As the lead counsel during the first impeachment of Donald Trump, Dan Goldman showed himself to be an intelligent and tenacious fighter for our democracy. Dan is raising his kids in this district and I know he will be the best person to safeguard New York and our nation from an anti-democratic Republican Party that is still under Trump’s control.”

Carroll is a leader on a host of critical issues and has sponsored key legislation defending against climate change and securing voting rights. As a former election lawyer, he also understands that the threats to our democracy are real and urgent and that we need voices in Congress with the skill and experience to protect it.

Carroll is a committed public servant with deep ties to the NY-10 community, and Dan is proud to stand with him in the existential fight for our nation’s future. Our campaign is grateful for his support.

- Team Goldman

Dan Goldman is running for Congress to protect our democracy and defend our fundamental rights at a moment when there have never been greater threats to both.

I wanted to take a moment and give you a quick update from the campaign trail, and thank everyone who worked so hard over the past couple of months to help us secure a spot on the November ballot here in CA-41.

I know it’s been a difficult time for our country, but I want you to know that this campaign remains committed to holding extremists accountable and fighting for our shared values – an economy that works for the middle class, affordable and accessible health care, reproductive rights, responsible gun laws, and a clean environment.

Below are a few recent highlights from the trail. I hope you enjoy the photos, and if you have any questions or concerns, feel free to respond to this email directly.

Thanks,

Will

* * *

**Last week, the team and I celebrated our nation’s independence at Corona’s Main Street Parade.** It was great to meet new voters and share our vision for CA-41.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/47531683/354658382/192312732?refcode=em-7.7.22-all-b&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85MzcxMSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1YTAxMTgyZS00ZGZlLWVjMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=058EJo-AQfku_eLESyF-UXRuW2zQ-j7gpKo3nZqTG4k=)
**Last week, my partner and I had the chance to meet and speak with Senator Cory Booker.** We’re thankful for his leadership in fighting for equal justice. As a personal aside, I admire his commitment to the kind of dad jokes that I’m always trying to land.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/47531685/354658384/192312732?refcode=em-7.7.22-all-b&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85MzcxMSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1YTAxMTgyZS00ZGZlLWVjMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=058EJo-AQfku_eLESyF-UXRuW2zQ-j7gpKo3nZqTG4k=)
I had a blast meeting local Democrats at an event hosted by Tony Hoyt, Mark Daniels, Janet Haire, and Maggie Cahill in Palm Springs. We discussed a range of issues and attendees had a lot of great questions. **If you're interested in hosting a house party or an event, respond to this email to let us know.**
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/47531687/354658386/192312732?refcode=em-7.7.22-all-b&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85MzcxMSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1YTAxMTgyZS00ZGZlLWVjMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=058EJo-AQfku_eLESyF-UXRuW2zQ-j7gpKo3nZqTG4k=)
**It was my honor to stand with so many across CA-41 who stood up for commonsense gun reform over the last few weeks.** Your enthusiasm and resolve will not go unnoticed.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/47531689/354658388/192312732?refcode=em-7.7.22-all-b&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85MzcxMSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1YTAxMTgyZS00ZGZlLWVjMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=058EJo-AQfku_eLESyF-UXRuW2zQ-j7gpKo3nZqTG4k=)

Thanks again for all that you do,

Will

# **In Case You Missed It:

‘America First’ GOP Candidate Dan Cox Openly Courts Democrats In Heated Primary**

From: [Daily Caller](https://kellyschulzforgovernor.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=05f3d1aa190e2cb084d25c5f0&id=fbb3eac1c1&e=64ac72257a)

## _"[Cox] also has the backing of the Democratic Governors’ Association (DGA), which has spent more than $1 million promoting him to GOP primary voters."_

---
| Daily Caller
Michael Ginsberg and Dylan Housman
July 6, 2022

“Democrats are propping up the ‘America First’ candidate in Maryland’s gubernatorial Republican primary, and the campaign is openly courting Democratic voters in return.

“Dan Cox, a Republican state delegate and lawyer, has claimed the mantle of ‘America First’ candidate for Maryland governor, and is endorsed by former President Donald Trump. He also has the backing of the Democratic Governors’ Association (DGA), which has spent more than $1 million promoting him to GOP primary voters. ...

“Cox’s opponent in the primary, former state Secretary of Commerce and Secretary of Labor Kelly Schulz, has seized on the Democratic support to cast Cox as unelectable.

“He’s the only candidate that can ensure Democrats take back Maryland in 2022,’ a new ad from the Schulz campaign says. ‘Because if you vote for crazy, Democrats win.’

“Cox has made multiple social media posts urging Democrats to switch their party registration to vote for him in the Republican primary. ‘We need EVERY Republican to vote and we need EVERY America First independent and Democrat to switch parties for our Primary Elections to vote for Dan Cox,’ he posted on Facebook in May.

“Cox posted a reminder on June 27 that the following day was the deadline to switch party registration before the primary, which occurs July 19. Another post in May gives instructions for voters to change party registration if they aren’t registered as a Republican. ...

“The delegate has faced criticism for refusing town hall-style appearances at the Maryland Municipal League, and declining media requests from local news outlets like Maryland Matters and The Baltimore Sun. ...”

Patriot,

Yesterday, I received an email from the Southern Poverty Law Center (SPLC) asking for comment on an article they were about to publish, and they gave me less than four hours to respond.

Of course, I was outside knocking doors and speaking to voters, and not checking email. So, SPLC ran with an article, without my comment, **linking me to alleged "hate groups," aka every single conservative Republican they disagree with.**

But here's the funny thing. **The SPLC is a hate group itself** , whose leadership has been exposed for pedophilia. SPLC's co-founder, Morris Dees, **attempted to molest his own stepdaughter after giving her wine according to divorce documents filed by his ex-wife.**

Dees was fired in 2019 by the SPLC amid "allegations of mistreatment, sexual harassment, gender discrimination and racism."

How ironic! Especially for the publication that wants to call me a White Supremacist.

The allegations of molestation against Dees go all the way back to 1979 . . . **and yet he remained on the job at SPLC for another 40 years!**

How dare an organization with such a shady and hypocritical background even try judge to me or slander me with their fake news hit piece!

But, I'm not the only one being judged by this actual leftwing hate group. **The SPLC is judging YOUR behavior and trying to cancel you for it.**

In 2018, Facebook admitted that they use the SPLC as "external experts to inform our hate speech policies."

**If you use Facebook, you 're under the thumb of the SPLC with everything that you post.**

Back to the article the SPLC wrote about me, of course they mentioned my congressional race against RINO incumbent Daniel Webster . . . and make no mistake, expect my political opponents to use these lies against me.

That's just how this goes. Politics is ugly, and we have to fight to define ourselves before the opposition does.

As a friend once told me, "The law of the jungle is eat, or be eaten. The law of politics is define, or be defined."

That's why it's so important for me to define myself and get in front of as many voters as possible in my district. [Will you help make this happen?](https://libersend.lauraloomerforcongress.com/l/jaHkxHkvgw3mMH3vyc0Hsw/AByEeHVIe6D90Q9il1f6dw/mV7PKryUNaT3nibJnI8EeA)

body:
There’s been a lot of talk about the filibuster.
# [](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/143?refcode=em20220707-3171-header&t=1&akid=3171%2E2526796%2En8slFe)
In the wake of the recent SCOTUS decisions, there’s been a lot of talk about the filibuster. During a recent “Ask me anything” on Instagram, someone asked Alexandria:
_**Why is the filibuster preventing Democrats from passing things but wasn’t for Republicans before?**_
In case you have questions too, we wanted to share Alexandria’s response:
[](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20220707.-Y6DLP&refcode=em20220707-3171-P_FND_EXP_LEG&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=3171%2E2526796%2En8slFe)
Alexandria has been clear that in order to protect and grow our majority, we must do anything and everything we can to protect people _now_. Not just tell them to vote in November.
Alexandria put forth a list of policy solutions that we can enact _now_ to save lives and show the base of Democratic supporters that we are serious about protecting their rights.1
They include:
\- Restrain judicial review
\- Expand the court
\- Clinics on federal lands
\- Expand education and access to Plan C
\- Repeal Hyde Amendment
\- Hold floor votes codifying Griswold, Obergefell, Lawrence, Loving, etc
\- Vote on Escobar’s bill protecting clinics

There are a lot of reasons why it’s so important that we elect Charlie Crist this November, but they all come down to one simple fact: **Ron DeSantis is too extreme for Florida.** During his first term in office, DeSantis showed us exactly what his priorities are:
* He’s weakened gun safety laws and vowed to **ban background checks on gun sales**.

* He’s placed **huge restrictions on voting rights** , making it even harder to defeat him at the polls.

* He’s **attacked companies and organizations that dared to disagree** with his hateful and discriminatory policies, like he did to Disney and the Special Olympics.

* And he’s vowed to **take away Floridians’ reproductive freedoms** , affecting women not only in our own state, but across the entire South who may travel here to seek care.

body:
It has been a privilege to represent the wonderful people of North Carolina, but I’m not ready to give up on this position just yet. | [](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=5dfab954e008418a9cdf9af5aa9f2443&_e=jtTwTJcodgvzkPLDPS2cIObNaTY8lLlqM8JNj7nUPA3CumduNANJzErz8U-6KRIPv9cp2WlpDIUoLFY7m2nBZk0Vubw1TXieKNnD6q5v3bcK8s_sttn_SuAvoWkMHlnx3PIuzJR2lnsejFnOJ-19wWPAt_Id1lUQnEk9RM0Ec48mH5-gpwXkL5pVwAGNsZKKUpBPAQOj4CtyB81d9GNrGht0dlSDzgIQmcuYU2dtmvDy-loptVEV0ptTwyqowp-1Aq-g8raXeLekAgnnub55Ml97phmACk4wb5G7THaNiLhTUoJn8f3y37KmDD94XTsaXvBB2WJVxU6lkdGvdJXb1ZAIPbaIX-Xdh8uYD0Murv_LKYtj5YpJOVpCDU1eVWpD)

Fellow Conservative,

Do you know _why_ I decided to become a doctor?

It’s because I knew that many people across the world and within our great country **desperately needed help**. I truly believe that God called on me to assist others during their times of hardship because he knew that I could carry the burdens of those I deliver aid to, improving their lives tremendously.

As a result, the past 35 years of my life have been spent in the medical field.

I graduated magna cum laude from Davidson College in 1985 and then graduated with honors from the UNC School of Medicine. I completed a surgical residency in Urology and Renal Transplantation at the University of Kentucky in Lexington and then opened up my own practice in Greenville, North Carolina, after moving there with my wife over 20 years ago.

I’ve traveled far and wide to places such as India, several parts of Africa, Nicaragua and Haiti as a Medical Missionary, serving both God and people from all walks of life. During this time, I was fortunate enough to meet Mother Teresa, who further inspired me to serve those in need.

My endeavors to lend a helping hand did not stop there. When Congressman Walter B. Jones, Jr. passed away in 2019 after 22 years of service and North Carolina was left without someone to represent their needs, **I felt called on to step up**.

For the past three years, I have been blessed to be able to serve the great people of North Carolina in Congress. Although this journey is a new one, I have learned it is not so different from working in the medical field. _**People want someone to care about their needs and take action to fix the issues that are causing them pain.**_

I excel as a congressman because I know how to take people’s problems into account, and work with individuals toward finding a solution that will result in them feeling great and living prosperously.

It has been a privilege to represent the wonderful people of North Carolina, _but I’m not ready to give up on this position just yet_. I wish to proceed with my duties and continue work on issues that are important to you.

In order for me to fulfill my earthly responsibility and keep North Carolina on course for prosperity, I must implore you to do something for me. [**Will you please stand behind me in solidarity with your financial support?**](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=5dfab954e008418a9cdf9af5aa9f2443&_e=jtTwTJcodgvzkPLDPS2cIObNaTY8lLlqM8JNj7nUPA3CumduNANJzErz8U-6KRIPv9cp2WlpDIUoLFY7m2nBZk0Vubw1TXieKNnD6q5v3bcK8s_sttn_SuAvoWkMHlnx3PIuzJR2lnsejFnOJ-19wWPAt_Id1lUQnEk9RM0Ec4__7_EhzbEpAhlxUbAwqMjBMg7oKVgrljwyjdu6jPrM3vHJyut54W1fzeAS6olHxEg28poMV3KHEdmTSeXuqW1ZFCJXPH4Qi2hR-JQmlEpa60sCOBaWLAwqyk4Va7JYtn3Yp0-tusyVZ-kin1Uu0lvUnpT930Gg6L3lmBYmEyuvSM4xqrB_CVtrB15zGBP_LS6TX3-CpvWf_LNXr3rJS87K)

I am aware that what I’m asking may be difficult, but it is necessary – especially if we want to continue our hard work. subject: Add your name: Expand the Supreme Court

body:
Congress must abolish the filibuster and expand the Court so President Biden can immediately appoint Justices that will protect our rights, freedoms, environment, and democracy.
#
Peter,
A radical, extremist Supreme Court is taking away our rights. SCOTUS stepped in to overturn settled precedent on abortion access, gun safety, environmental protections, and much more.
**Expanding the Supreme Court is a key way to fight back** — Congress must abolish the filibuster and expand the Court so President Biden can immediately appoint Justices that will protect our rights, freedoms, environment, and democracy. If we don’t act now after such a destructive Court term, our democracy is in serious jeopardy.
[**Peter, will you stand with me today and sign on to my call to Expand the Court? Add your name to show you’re ready to take bold action to protect abortion rights, our democracy, and so much more.**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/signup/expand-the-court/?source=em20220707-1405&t=1&akid=1405%2E420207%2EmdLQAI)
**[Add your name](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/signup/expand-the-court/?source=em20220707-1405&t=2&akid=1405%2E420207%2EmdLQAI)**
I’m leading the Congressional Progressive Caucus in a push to make this a reality — because the Court’s extreme decisions are the result of a decades-long right-wing project to stack the Court with far right ideologues that will overrule precedent and the will of the American people.
Serious and specific questions persist about the ethics of conservative Justices like Clarence Thomas. Three others appear to have misled the Senate Judiciary Committee about _Roe v. Wade_ being settled precedent. The Supreme Court has overreached its authority and destroyed its legitimacy.
We must act quickly to pass the Judiciary Act to add Justices to the Supreme Court and pass my bill with Senator Elizabeth Warren (Judicial Ethics and Anti-Corruption Act) to overhaul our nation’s judicial ethics laws and restore public faith in our court system.
[**Peter, please show your support for Expanding the Court today so we can build the momentum we need to get this done and reverse the damage done by the extreme Supreme Court.**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/signup/expand-the-court/?source=em20220707-1405&t=3&akid=1405%2E420207%2EmdLQAI)
**[Add your name](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/signup/expand-the-court/?source=em20220707-1405&t=4&akid=1405%2E420207%2EmdLQAI)**
Thank you for taking action today.
In solidarity,
Pramila

| | **This Week on the Campaign Trail** Hung was honored to participate in so many parades celebrating this great country on the 4th of July! He loved getting to walk with his family, staff, and volunteers in the Leesburg Parade, Manassas Fair, and Purcellville Parade. The patriotism and pride throughout the district was so uplifting. Hung and the Cao Herd want to carry that energy and enthusiasm all the way to the polls in November! Hung would like to thank every single person who helped organize, plan, execute or participate in these events. It was a busy day, but keeping the spirit of America alive and well is integral to the success of this nation. A special thanks to the Loudoun County Republican Committee, Manassas Republicans, Ian Lovejoy, Lynn Forkell and Teresa Ellis for everything they did to coordinate such wonderful events!
---
---
---
A big thank you to the American Telugu Association for the convention they put on last week! Hung loves celebrating culture, family, and shared values. Thank you to Srilika Palle for your support and coordination efforts. The convention was a hit!
---
---
Hung had a blast throwing out the game ball at Twilight Polo in The Plains last week! After giving some brief remarks, Hung spoke with residents of Fauquier County about issues facing the 10th District. Although the weather was beautiful, there is a storm coming this November! Let’s push that Red Wave!
---
---
If you didn’t catch the Cao Team at Leesburg’s First Friday event we will be going to others! Keep a lookout on our calendar for more First Friday events in the District! Hung loves talking with residents and getting out into his community. We need politicians that are in-touch with the needs of their constituents and prioritize true connection.

clean_body: | | | | | July 7th 2022 | WEEKLY NEWSLETTER | Issue 4 | | This Week on the Campaign Trail Hung was honored to participate in so many parades celebrating this great country on the 4th of July! He loved getting to walk with his family, staff, and volunteers in the Leesburg Parade, Manassas Fair, and Purcellville Parade. The patriotism and pride throughout the district was so uplifting. Hung and the Cao Herd want to carry that energy and enthusiasm all the way to the polls in November! Hung would like to thank every single person who helped organize, plan, execute or participate in these events. It was a busy day, but keeping the spirit of America alive and well is integral to the success of this nation. A special thanks to the Loudoun County Republican Committee, Manassas Republicans, Ian Lovejoy, Lynn Forkell and Teresa Ellis for everything they did to coordinate such wonderful events! A big thank you to the American Telugu Association for the convention they put on last week! Hung loves celebrating culture, family, and shared values. Thank you to Srilika Palle for your support and coordination efforts. The convention was a hit! Hung had a blast throwing out the game ball at Twilight Polo in The Plains last week! After giving some brief remarks, Hung spoke with residents of Fauquier County about issues facing the 10th District. Although the weather was beautiful, there is a storm coming this November! Let’s push that Red Wave! If you didn’t catch the Cao Team at Leesburg’s First Friday event we will be going to others! Keep a lookout on our calendar for more First Friday events in the District! Hung loves talking with residents and getting out into his community. We need politicians that are in-touch with the needs of their constituents and prioritize true connection. | Join Us If you haven’t signed up for the Paint The House Red Gala, you still have time! In 2018, Facebook admitted that they use the SPLC as "external experts to inform our hate speech policies."

**If you use Facebook, you 're under the thumb of the SPLC with everything that you post.**

Back to the article the SPLC wrote about me, of course they mentioned my congressional race against RINO incumbent Daniel Webster . . . and make no mistake, expect my political opponents to use these lies against me.

That's just how this goes. Politics is ugly, and we have to fight to define ourselves before the opposition does.

As a friend once told me, "The law of the jungle is eat, or be eaten. The law of politics is define, or be defined."

That's why it's so important for me to define myself and get in front of as many voters as possible in my district. [Will you help make this happen?](https://libersend.loomered.com/l/bZPeCTAajmzyaMKwCIY0iA/xyosnZQaImvQkHsspMs5EA/biFm3XJGhomrfpRVyFENPw)

disclaimer_text: Paid for by Run Betsy Run The Betsy Brigade needs you to recapture Oregon’s independent spirit
body:
[](https://www.runbetsyrun.com/?e=40b20d4397498f3af7dfb5987b4a98d3&utm_source=rbr&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=20220707_f2&n=1) | Dear Friend, I have great news and good news. The great news is we’ve just emerged from July 4th weekend with the chance to make November 8th Oregon’s true Independence Day. As of this moment, both of our two major party opponents are trapped in a world of their extreme institutional interests and ideological bases. **In progressive-leaning Oregon, Tina Kotek has only 33% support, while Christine Drazan has only a weak 23% share of the vote.** Ours are the only numbers that continue to grow over the last few months as we have moved up from 19% in March to a full 30% support today. **There are still 15% of the state’s voters who are undecided,** but half of them say they prefer a common-sense independent to traditional progressive or conservative choices – they just don’t know Betsy yet. We are well positioned to take this race into the fall and emerge with a historic chance to help Oregon fly with her own wings – or at least Betsy's. [](https://www.runbetsyrun.com/r?u=sTrCoaT-YmDhY88aC-xe_4wuZ-2t-UfLCO31ykNad3IpZEmWqyffPUGUGo7kVPPkAacKZ6St4NkcRw7yA3_kafdVfd_2z17macjNLCN1MK8zjaVM6Z8gifeXz92Km8j2&e=40b20d4397498f3af7dfb5987b4a98d3&utm_source=rbr&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=20220707_f2&n=2) **And now, for the merely good news, we need more of your help.** We are succeeding because the message of this campaign – that we can bring Oregon together in a new way to move our state forward – is not only the way that Betsy will govern, it’s the way this campaign is being built. All across Oregon, Democrats, Republicans and unaffiliated voters are realizing that it’s time we put Oregon first, but back in Washington, D.C., political operatives are seeing the same poll numbers and starting to panic. They are about to throw the kitchen sink at us, and we need your help to keep giving Oregonians a real choice between the two extremes. [CLICK HERE TO HELP BETSY NOW](https://www.runbetsyrun.com/r?u=sTrCoaT-YmDhY88aC-xe_4wuZ-2t-UfLCO31ykNad3IpZEmWqyffPUGUGo7kVPPkAacKZ6St4NkcRw7yA3_kafdVfd_2z17macjNLCN1MK8zjaVM6Z8gifeXz92Km8j2&e=40b20d4397498f3af7dfb5987b4a98d3&utm_source=rbr&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=20220707_f2&n=3) **We are on the verge of doing something truly historic and critical for Oregon, but we can’t do it without you. body:
[1]Charles Booker

Peter,

I’ve been traveling to Eastern Kentucky the past few weeks to join rallies
for reproductive justice and stand in solidarity with Kentucky families,
and I want to tell you what I saw.

In Pikeville, we heard from Kentuckians who shared deeply personal stories
about their own pregnancies, health related issues, and how the Supreme
Court’s will impact others in similar situations.

[ https://act.charlesbooker.org/go/18293?c0=20220707.IMgqrv&refcode=em20220707-2193&t=1001&akid=2193%2E346206%2Eld3nuF ][IMG]

In Ashland, on the Fourth of July, hundreds of Kentuckians locked arms to
send a message loud and clear that we will not back down from this fight.

[ https://act.charlesbooker.org/go/18293?c0=20220707.IMgqrv&refcode=em20220707-2193&t=1002&akid=2193%2E346206%2Eld3nuF ][IMG]

Peter, what I
saw in Eastern Kentucky, and what I’ve seen across the Commonwealth, has
shown me an important fact: From the hood to the holler, the people of
Kentucky are fired up. We’re fired up to win back the freedoms that were
taken from us by the Supreme Court, and we’re fired up to take back our
Senate seat in November.

We can take our power back. We can build a Senate that works for all of us
— not just Mitch and Rand and their powerful friends. [ https://act.charlesbooker.org/go/18293?c0=20220707.IMgqrv&refcode=em20220707-2193&t=1003&akid=2193%2E346206%2Eld3nuF ]Can you help me
get one step closer to winning this November by chipping in
$5 today?

[ https://act.charlesbooker.org/go/18293?c0=20220707.IMgqrv&refcode=em20220707-2193&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1022&akid=2193%2E346206%2Eld3nuF ]Contribute $5

For years, our rights have been under attack in Kentucky. They’ve wanted
to not just ban all abortion, but block our Commonwealth from moving
forward.

What the Roe v. Wade ruling from the Supreme Court means is that access to
quality healthcare in rural areas, especially Appalachia, is now even
harder to access. The ruling is an invasion of big government into our
lives and is the strongest form of government overreach in modern history.

We cannot — and we will not be silent — about this. This is bigger than
any political party, or candidate, this is about humanity. We will stand
up and fight back, because the people of Kentucky are worth fighting for.

[ https://act.charlesbooker.org/go/18293?c0=20220707.IMgqrv&refcode=em20220707-2193&t=1023&akid=2193%2E346206%2Eld3nuF ]Day by day, we’re building the momentum to send our movement to the
Senate. Will you chip in $5 today to help make sure we BEAT
Rand Paul and begin to build a Kentucky that works for all of this
November?

The time to act is now. Kentucky is fighting back.

Thank you,
Peter.

Charles Booker

disclaimer_text: Paid for by Dr. Annie Andrews for Congress
body:
| When I decided to become a Pediatrician, I could have never imagined the number of children with bullet holes I would care for in my career.

I will never forget the image of the 3 year old, sitting alone in her hospital room, with her babydoll next to her. Her brother had found an unsecure gun at home and unintentionally shot her in the face. She lost her eye and her face was disfigured.

Nancy Mace proudly calls herself a “Second Amendment girl” and voted against even the smallest gun violence prevention legislation. That’s why we’ve got to vote her out.

I just shared my policy for how I’m going to combat gun violence as your member of Congress because I know how critical this issue is—it’s life or death. But I need you to say you're in this fight with me.

I am touched beyond words at this acknowledgement of President Biden’s faith in me.
#

On Gabby’s special day, please make a contribution of any amount you can afford to help us continue the work of making our communities safer from gun violence.
**[CONTRIBUTE NOW](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-july22.Xk0RhP&refcode=em220707-1-15&t=1&akid=2211%2E3935704%2EL_gWMM)**
* * *
[](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-july22.Xk0RhP&refcode=em220707-1-15&t=2&akid=2211%2E3935704%2EL_gWMM)
Gabby receives the Presidential Medal of Freedom from President Biden
Friends -
Since I was shot more than 11 years ago, my personal recovery journey has taught me that it’s not the setback that defines us: it’s how we respond to it.
There have been no shortage of setbacks as I relearned how to talk and how to walk, just as there have been no shortage of setbacks in the fight for gun safety that I’ve dedicated my life to.
And yet I’ve never lost hope.
One of my reasons for hope sits inside the Oval Office today. President Biden was elected to accomplish the near-impossible task of healing a divided nation and my faith in him has never faltered.
I am touched beyond words at this acknowledgement of his faith in me.
I never could have imagined the path my life would take, but public service has always been and will always be my north star.
I am thankful that you have been with me every step of the way, during my time as an elected official and in our work together to make our communities safer from gun violence.
It is the honor of a lifetime to receive this award, but it was a team effort.
With courage,
Gabby Giffords
* * *
**Please make a contribution—of any amount you can afford—to stand with Gabby in the fight to make our communities safer from gun violence. There is only one way we create the change we need, and that is together.**

body:
Together, we transformed our political landscape. | | | [](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/wehEm_vu1NBVXOKYSqOxTOi34aJoCJC1EivM7Ih953yOQozAy4249GfohatM8XLCP7Gyf6bzrkjN8sXh_JjXvDm21fvmGLhqUe-quR3_x0a4ZLzkfrFqdtVKuNIuwQsn0c91jgEdSA5OANsq926BffC7faAQGaBY74u73WFJVk5_7dm8Ty4REYwj7zNXQFJK4kOv--gIewW1FozuHbC0GKV3AnRC3Xxe8J-nq0upjbRiz0lXt4KC36j0uNHIJ0vCnn-ZzQ9AO_NNf04hvH4xQPSZ6W_IDitstyEOPaviuJfX2OVKCmJUzeansOK2zfe5Ex7JE6W0SrpRmx96WXEixYKwtBelb0sM0cQKjsiR_sVhWpIXOFFqIFzECj3vwBp4/3nj/QO4b3tQXSUy7Eu5rK9sDDQ/h0/Wy9CUbLr7rhtb9G2kOAVe9tLlC_r6bKwRiA5RaXImBk) Dear Friends, It has been just over a week since our election on June 28th, and now that we have had a few days to recharge and reflect, I wanted to reach out, and express my deepest gratitude to all of you. This election was about giving our city a better vision for the future. A future free of gun violence where we take on the corporate class with Green New Deal union jobs, universal healthcare, and a fully funded public education. A future where we strengthen our labor movement, protect our reproductive rights, and finally end poverty. The campaign that we built together showed everyone that a young Black woman from the West Side of Chicago can take on the Chicago machine without a dime of corporate money. My opponent had to call in every political favor, from the President of the United States & Speaker of the House, to the Mayor of Chicago and the Governor of Illinois, only to barely win. **I am proud to say that after 40,000 doors knocked, 300,000 phones called, and over $840,000 raised, they can never ignore our movement again.** I am so grateful to all of you for every donation, every knock on a door, every house party, every phone call, every parade, and every meeting that you made possible over the course of this campaign. Together, we transformed our political landscape. This isn’t the end, it’s just the beginning. In Solidarity, Kina Collins | This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com.

| | **2022 July e-newsletter**
**County makes huge investment for youth struggling with mental health issues in the Jefferson Union High School District**
Dear friends, San Mateo County has approved a resolution that will expand and increase our investments into mental health care for students in the Jefferson Union High School District. I am excited to see the work that the Daly City Youth Health Center will be able to accomplish for our youth in north San Mateo County with these much-needed funds. Now more than ever, we must invest resources into programs that help our youth work through mental health issues. Our youth are our future, we must work to provide the best outcomes for them. That is why I am proud that we at the county are providing another $954,564 in funding to this important resource. The Board of Supervisors adopted the resolution at its June 28 meeting which authorizes an amendment to the agreement with Jefferson Union High School District for mental health services, alcohol and other drug prevention services, and the Daly City Youth Center COVID Youth Resiliency Response Initiative, extending the term through June 30, 2023, and increasing the amount by $954,564 to an amount not to exceed $2,114,182. These are investments well spent and shows the county’s commitment to our youth as we continue to emerge from the pandemic. **County budget focuses on recovery, ending homelessness** The San Mateo County Board of Supervisors approved a $3.4 billion recommended budget for the 2022-23 fiscal year at its June 28 meeting with a focus on priorities including pandemic recovery, ending homelessness, social justice and equity. Some revisions to the budget will be made in September and my hope is to add some increased investments into childcare, including a new Learning Center slated to be built at the Midway Village Project under redevelopment in Daly City’s Bayshore neighborhood. As the pandemic is not yet over, the budget provides both short-term emergency funding and long-term relief for individuals and businesses. Highlights of the budget include $140 million for affordable housing, $90 million for our most vulnerable residents including the homeless, $30 million in economic recovery and $20 million for children and families. This budget is a moral document that reflects the Board’s values of inclusion and equity and making sure that no one gets left behind. **Assault on abortion ends at the California border** As the Supreme Court overturned Roe v. Wade in June, the county made a $1 million investment to ensure that women not only here but in states across the country can access safe abortions in San Mateo County. On the day the decision was made, I was proud to stand alongside so many women and men at an evening “Rally for Reproductive Rights” in San Mateo Central Park. The assault on women’s reproductive freedoms ends at the California border! While the SCOTUS decision gives red states the green light to ban abortions, here in California we must fight harder than ever to protect and expand women’s rights. The San Mateo County Board of Supervisors took the following actions at its June 14 meeting in response to the expected SCOTUS decision: The Board created a subcommittee on Women’s Reproductive Freedom and Healthcare Privacy; and accept the San Mateo County Action Plan to Support Women’s Reproductive Freedom and Healthcare Privacy; and allocating up to $1 million in two tranches, $549,312 for immediate purchase of technology and medical equipment for clinics operated by Planned Parenthood Mar Monte, and up to an additional $450,688 to be allocated later based on Board consideration of recommendations from the Women’s Reproductive Freedom and Healthcare Privacy Subcommittee. The Board also authorized the County Executive to enter into an agreement with Planned Parenthood Mar Monte for the purchase of technology and medical equipment in the amount of $549,312; and directing staff to present a Women’s Reproductive Freedom and Healthcare Privacy advocacy agenda to the Board for consideration no later than August 2, 2022.
**We are failing our children when we don’t act on guns** Following the tragic mass shooting at an elementary school in Texas that left 19 children and two teachers dead in June, several vigils were held in San Mateo County to the mourn the loss and to advocate for greater gun control laws. I attended two somber events in Foster City and Daly City where many young people spoke on how they have lived their entire lives seeing mass shootings at schools become almost routine. They expressed heartbreak and asked repeatedly what is our government doing to protect children from being killed by guns at our schools? Although California has some of the strictest gun laws in the state, even here we have seen mass shootings, one most recently in downtown Sacramento that left several dead. Democrats in Congress have called for universal background checks, raising the age limit from 18 to 21, lengthening the time between purchasing a gun and it being delivered and banning assault rifles. But the powerful gun lobby, fueled by the National Rifle Association, has got a stranglehold on the Republican Party which has refused to act on any of those initiatives. In response to gun violence, San Mateo County sponsored a very successful gun buyback in South San Francisco I attended that took hundreds of guns, rifles and even ghost guns out of our homes and off our streets. In this day and age, I am urging our residents to sell their guns rather than buy them. It’s a least one way to know that those firearms can no longer be a threat to our children. Gun buybacks are conducted throughout the county throughout the year and I urge you to consider selling your unwanted guns to provide a little peace of mind that we are making our communities safer from gun violence. As we celebrated our nation’s birth July 4, another mass shooting took place in Highland Park, Illinois at a Fourth of July parade that left 7 dead and injured two dozen others. It’s a heartbreaking story that puts yet another stain on this country. When will Congress act? **Battling food insecurity**
Food insecurity is a problem some residents may still face as we continue to emerge from the pandemic. Here are some resources residents can access: **CalFresh:**
Is a program for people with low-income who meet federal income eligibility rules and want to add to their budget to put healthy and nutritious food on the table. Website: [https://www.cdss.ca.gov/food-nutrition/calfresh](https://davidcanepa.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c7592558e548bc8cc150aa5&id=b3eed94c67&e=c0babbc643) Contact: (650) 802-6576, [antorres@smcgov.org](mailto:antorres@smcgov.org) **Daly City Partnership:**
DC Partnership is a local partnership that was formed to guide collaborative efforts and connect our community to services that promote well-being. Currently, DC Partnership has a drive-through food bank and free meals for students. Check out their website for times and locations. Website: [https://www.dcpartnership.org/covid19/](https://davidcanepa.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c7592558e548bc8cc150aa5&id=e705c89797&e=c0babbc643) **Second Harvest Food Bank:**
Second Harvest offers food at various locations throughout San Mateo County listed on its webpage. Website: [https://www.shfb.org/get-food/](https://davidcanepa.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c7592558e548bc8cc150aa5&id=395b91beaf&e=c0babbc643) Contacts: Call (800) 984-3663 or text GETFOOD to (408) 455-5181 **Interns wanted to join our team **

We are looking to add to our great group of interns we are currently working with. If you or someone you know may be interested in applying to my Internship Program, submitting this form is the first step: https://forms.gle/hiKqtn7Rird5vXwB9. You can also reach out to Mike Richardson on my staff directly with any questions at mrichardson@smcgov.org

**Follow the Office on Social Media**
If you want to get more insight into our office please connect with us on social media. It’s also a great way to interact with the office and to get notifications on upcoming events. Click the icons below and like us on Facebook and follow us on Twitter.** ** In friendship, David J. Canepa

# Thank you and stay tuned!

---
|
---
| Friends, I want to thank you and everyone for their love and support in my race to represent us in Congress. Your commitment motivated me and gave me the strength to run hard and forge a very strong campaign. I am truly grateful for the hard work and dedication of so many grassroots volunteers and the many donors who supported me, locally and all around the country. My campaign core team was the best I've ever worked with. Together, we are working on some VERY exciting ways to continue having an impact so please stay tuned. There will be news coming shortly. **A conservative agenda focused on Faith, Family and Freedom is desperately needed to revitalize our community, state and nation.**
---
|
## Counting the Votes
We chose to delay comments on the close outcome until we obtained enough information from the 7 county clerks about the vote by mail ballots. After careful analysis, it appears we were short of a victory. I wish Scott Gryder good luck in November.
## Special Thank you:

I thank the media who covered the race and a very special thanks to those who endorsed my run at the state and national level, including Congresswoman Mary Miller, former Congresswoman and Presidential Candidate, Michele Bachmann, Author and Researcher, Trevor Loudon, Anni Cyrus and many others.
---
|
---
## You can help:
Campaigns are a HUGE personal investment, especially for grassroots fighters. If you can send a small contribution (or large) to help retire some of the debts from the campaign, that would be greatly appreciated.

Most of all, I want to thank my beautiful wife Jill, my family and of course God, for protecting me during the campaign and blessing me with so many new and strengthened relationships. **THANK YOU AND STAY TUNED!**

body:
#

A lot has changed in just the past few weeks that I know has increased the urgency to act on some issues, and I wanted to get a sense of what your current priorities are.
**[Can you take our July issues survey to let us know what’s most important to you right now? Feedback from folks like you is important to me and can help inform our campaign’s messaging and strategy.**](https://act.cheribeasley.com/signup/july_issues_em/?source=em220707-1-ma&refcode2=1189.357359.gbWWu3&akid=1189%2E357359%2EgbWWu3)
**[TAKE OUR SURVEY](https://act.cheribeasley.com/signup/july_issues_em/?source=em220707-1-ma&refcode2=1189.357359.gbWWu3&akid=1189%2E357359%2EgbWWu3)**
I’ve made it a priority since we started this campaign to really listen to people — no matter their ZIP code. I believe that we deserve a Senator who will listen and be a voice for working people.
But I know we can’t always meet everyone while on the campaign trail, so this survey is a chance to hear from even more folks.
The response to surveys like this one help us see how people’s perspectives change or stay the same over time too. We know there are a lot of pressing issues, but this helps us keep a pulse on what’s most important to people like you.
**[So if you can spare just 1 minute, please take our latest issues survey. We’ll review the results soon, and I want to make sure your opinion is heard.**](https://act.cheribeasley.com/signup/july_issues_em/?source=em220707-1-ma&refcode2=1189.357359.gbWWu3&akid=1189%2E357359%2EgbWWu3)
Thank you in advance for sharing your perspective. I’m grateful to have your voice in this fight with us.
\- Cheri Beasley

Team,

Have you been watching the January 6 hearings? I have – and it's becoming ever clearer just how close our country came to a constitutional crisis.

It's also becoming clearer that **more must be done to ensure that the voice of the people is heard and election results are honored**.

It’s clear we can’t trust the GOP on that count. Many Republicans have repeated Trump's Big Lie, promoted voter suppression legislation, manipulated maps, and launched attacks on nonpartisan election officials – to say nothing of the 2022 GOP candidates who actually participated in January 6.

So what do we do? **We work to strengthen our institutions. We pass needed reforms. And – importantly – we make sure the officials who are in place for the next presidential election will uphold the will of the people, not that of an extremist minority.

That's part of our goal at the NDRC.** We're working to help elect Democrats who will reject voter suppression and gerrymandering, strengthen democratic institutions, and turn down attempts from Trump (or whoever else) to rig vote counts. But we can’t do it without you, so I have to ask, team: [_Can you make a donation today to support all of our work?_](https://click.everyaction.com/k/47533396/354690045/-1362630668?amount=20&refcode=20220707.3r_527&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImM4MGI1ZWIwLTYxZmUtZWMxMS1iNDdhLTI4MTg3OGI4M2Q4YSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=u0QG308iFg9K8RrQ4HeJ6puLHc61ygXFiKXZJiGBmW8=) | [](https://click.everyaction.com/k/47533397/354690046/-1362630668?amount=20&refcode=20220707.3r_527&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImM4MGI1ZWIwLTYxZmUtZWMxMS1iNDdhLTI4MTg3OGI4M2Q4YSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=u0QG308iFg9K8RrQ4HeJ6puLHc61ygXFiKXZJiGBmW8=)

| Team, if you’ve been tracking the public January 6 Committee hearings, you know the AZ GOP was heavily involved in that day’s events.

If you haven’t followed them, let’s catch you up real quick: Andy Biggs asked for a presidential pardon for his role in the events; AZ GOP chair Kelli Ward was subpoenaed by a federal grand jury; Paul Gosar is claiming he started “the revolution” on January 6; and everyone from Ginni Thomas to Rudy Giuliani pressured the AZ legislature to either accept fake electors or change the outcome.

**And we’re positive that’s not even everything.**

Today is an exciting day, friend! **It’s the first day of in-person early voting for the Maryland primary election.** I cast my ballot back home in Baltimore this afternoon surrounded by friends and family, and it was such a fulfilling moment to vote for this movement we’ve poured our hearts into over the past year. **Early voting is available over the course of a week, from today through next Thursday, July 14. Peter \-- Tim Walz KNOWS he's in trouble this November. That's why he had to show up in Northern Minnesota on the 4th of July where his fans are few and far between. **You see, the people up in the Iron Range were not happy with his shutdown of our state's economy. And they don't care much for how his administration constantly caters to the radical left-wing of the metro Democrats.** But since he needs votes in "Rocks and Cows" country, he marched in a couple parades up north. And that's where he ran into our young field operative, Jesse Smith, who was sporting our popular "Dump Walz" t-shirt. Jesse quickly got a photo with the tyrant-wannabe. Action 4 Liberty is a thorn in the side of Tim Walz. We're the group that led the charge against his illegal Emergency Powers and unconstitutional mandates. When rural Democrat legislators in the Minnesota House started voting to protect Walz' Emergency Powers last year, we moved a full time team of door knockers to the Iron Range, Moorehead and other districts to let voters know how their legislator was voting. One of those legislators is **Con Artist Julie Sandstede** (pictured in the top left of the photo). Her time in the Legislature is numbered because her voters know that she turned her back on them. Of the other 7 Con Artists who joined Sandstede in protecting Walz' powers, 3 of them have decided not to run again. They see the writing on the Walz (see what I did there?). Politicians who turn against our liberty, will pay the price. They know we're going to EXPOSE them. And the best place to expose their radical agenda is in front of millions of Minnesotans at the State Fair. **We're going to expose the Tim Walz, Radical Leftwing Agenda:** **\- Crushing lockdowns and mandates** **\- Holding on to our surplus during inflation** **\- Out-of-control crime** But doing the State Fair is just a pipe dream if we don't have the resources and army to help out. Because Action 4 Liberty is not backed by lobbyists and Special Interests - we're backed by YOU!
